jobs.excerpt: ⌘ Role OverviewThe Enablement & Operations Manager owns the systems, processes, and enablement that allow Customer Support and Trust & Safety to run consistently and at scale.
jobs.description:
⌘ Role Overview

The Enablement & Operations Manager owns the systems, processes, and enablement that allow Customer Support and Trust & Safety to run consistently and at scale. The role spans two connected areas: Enablement (knowledge and documentation standards, onboarding and training, and ownership of the quality programme) and Operations (tooling, Zendesk configuration, automation and AI-assisted workflows, taxonomies, and reporting).

This is a hands-on leadership role. You are the point of accountability for how the CX function operates day to day, expected to independently identify gaps, propose solutions, and drive them through to implementation. You stay close to reality through system monitoring, dashboards, and quality insight rather than frontline ticket handling, and you line-manage a QA Analyst.

⌘ Key Responsibilities

Enablement, Knowledge & Training

  • Own the Help Centre and internal support documentation standards, including macros, workflows, and SOPs.
  • Own onboarding and ramp frameworks and set training priorities so representatives are consistently well-equipped.
  • Keep knowledge content accurate, current, and easy for the team to apply, closing gaps proactively.

Quality

  • Own the QA framework and standards across the CX function.
  • Line-manage a QA Analyst, and turn quality findings into coaching, content, process, and automation improvements.

CX Systems, Tooling & Automation

  • Own CX tooling standards and Zendesk system configuration: routing, triggers, automations, and escalation logic across Customer Support and Trust & Safety.
  • Lead the continuous rollout and governance of AI-assisted support and moderation workflows, including prompt configuration, automation rules, quality checks, and safeguards.
  • Own intent, sentiment, and feedback taxonomies, ensuring tagging reflects customer context and risk.
  • Monitor automation performance and decide when adjustments, safeguards, or rollbacks are needed.

Insights, Reporting & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Own CX operational dashboards and reporting standards, giving leadership timely visibility into volume, automation performance, sentiment, and trends.
  • Represent CX systems and enablement in cross-functional work with Product, Tech, Data, and Operations, supporting launches, policy, and process changes.

⌘ Expected Outcomes

Within 6–12 months, success looks like:

  • CX teams operate on clear, stable, well-governed systems and documentation.
  • Zendesk workflows, automations, and escalation paths support Customer Support and Trust & Safety without friction.
  • AI-assisted workflows are trusted, monitored, and governed, with clear quality controls.
  • The Help Centre and internal documentation are rebuilt to standard and consistently used.
  • Quality is measured through a clear framework, with the QA Analyst delivering reliable insight.
  • CX leadership has early visibility into pain points, safety risks, and operational bottlenecks.

⌘ Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of CX operations and customer-facing workflows.
  • Proven experience owning CX tooling and operational systems, especially Zendesk.
  • Ability to design, test, and QA automation and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Systems-oriented thinker with strong execution discipline and attention to detail in quality- and risk-sensitive environments.
  • Data-literate, comfortable working with dashboards and operational metrics.
  • Clear communicator and effective people manager, able to influence peers and stakeholders.

⌘ Required Experience

  • 3–5+ years in CX Operations, Support Operations, or Enablement, or a closely related role.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Zendesk (configuration, workflows, routing, reporting).
  • Experience leading automation or tooling initiatives in an operational environment.
  • Experience managing or coaching others.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted support or moderation tools is a plus.
  • Strong fluency in English required.

⌘ Recruitment process

  • Introduction Interview (30min): A conversation with Talent Acquisition to discuss your experience, goals, and fit with Timeleft's mission.
  • Panel Interview (45min): A joint conversation with the Customer Support Manager and Trust & Safety Manager, the peers you'll partner with most closely.
  • Take-Home Test: A practical exercise reflecting typical operational and tooling scenarios in the role.
  • Final Interview (45min): A follow-up with the Head of Customer Experience to review your take-home and confirm alignment.

jobs.title: Senior Director - Product Management - EU Veeva Nitro
jobs.excerpt: Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together.
jobs.description:
Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.

We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.

The Role

As Senior Director, Product Management for EU, you will be Veeva Nitro's senior product presence in Europe. Nitro is our AI-native data platform that democratizes life sciences data for non-technical commercial teams, turning fragmented HCP/HCO, prescription, and industry data into decisions the field can act on.
Europe is a critical and complex market for Nitro, with multi-country field operations, strict data privacy requirements, and sophisticated customers who expect a platform that understands their world. You will deeply understand EU customers, advocate for their needs in the global product roadmap, and partner with engineering to deliver on those needs. You'll work across product, engineering, sales, services, legal, and compliance to ensure Nitro is built for Europe and wins in Europe.
You are an AI-native product leader who thinks about what the platform should decide and recommend, not just what it should store or display. You measure success with outcomes — product adoption, customer satisfaction, deal velocity, renewals, expansions. You are equally credible in a customer boardroom in Paris and in a roadmap review with engineering. You are energized by working at startup speed inside a global enterprise.

What You'll Do

  • EU Customer Discovery & Advocacy: Own the EU customer relationship pipeline, from discovery interviews to exec briefings to conference presence. You are the primary feedback loop between European pharma and the global roadmap
  • EU Product Delivery: Set priorities for the dedicated EU engineering workstream and own the outcomes of those features
  • Regulatory & Data Compliance: Own the product's compliance posture in Europe. Partner with legal and security to ensure Nitro meets GDPR, data residency, and EMA requirements, and turn compliance into a competitive strength
  • Go-to-Market Partnership: Get in the room early on EU deals. Partner with sales and services to position Nitro, handle product objections, and accelerate time-to-value for new customers
  • Market Intelligence: Know the EU competitive landscape, regulatory pipeline, and local data ecosystem, and use it to influence product strategy
  • AI-Native Product Leadership: Push the product toward innovative capabilities and ways of working, rather than automating existing processes. Be the voice in EU customer rooms that articulates what AI-native analytics actually means for commercial teams
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Connect the dots across engineering, legal, security, compliance, services, and consulting so EU commitments land
  • Executive Alignment: Represent the EU market and customer perspective to Veeva and Nitro leadership. Bring a clear point of view on where to invest, what's working, and what needs to change

Requirements

  • Leadership: 8+ years in product management with demonstrated success on enterprise SaaS or data platforms
  • Domain Expertise: Deep life sciences commercial, medical, and regulatory expertise including HCP/HCO data, Rx/prescription data, claims, and field force operations, ideally across multiple EU markets
  • EU Market Expertise: Strong understanding of the European life sciences market, multi-country dynamics, and EU regulatory and data-privacy requirements including GDPR, data residency, and EMA
  • AI/Data Fluency: Hands-on product experience with AI/ML, analytics, or data platforms with the ability to shape and advocate for AI-driven capabilities and hold a credible product conversation with customers and engineering alike
  • Customer Obsession: Builds relationships that go beyond the sale, with deep knowledge of customer workflows, frustrations, and definitions of success
  • Data-Driven: Sets clear success metrics and uses data to prioritize, advocate, and report on outcomes
  • Customer-Facing Credibility: Proven ability to lead executive customer conversations and translate them into product direction
  • Execution: Comfortable influencing across teams in a globally distributed, remote-first environment
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or higher; equivalent experience considered

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Veeva Vault, Veeva CRM, or the broader life sciences technology ecosystem
  • Experience building or scaling an AI-native product from an early stage
  • Working proficiency in one or more European languages beyond English

Interviewing with Veeva

    We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

  • Compensation: Highly competitive salary and equity in Veeva
  • Growth: Unrivalled career progression in a fast-growing, global team
  • Flexibility: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can work from home or the office on any given day
#RemoteUK
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.

jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote – South Africa Working Hours: US Hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST) Salary: R 23,500–26,000 About the RoleWe are looking for a highly organised, proactive and people-focused Clinical Compliance Coordinator to support a US-based healthcare organisation operating within the Applied Behaviour Analysis (ABA) therapy space.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote – South Africa
Working Hours: US Hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST)
Salary: R 23,500–26,000

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and people-focused Clinical Compliance Coordinator to support a US-based healthcare organisation operating within the Applied Behaviour Analysis (ABA) therapy space.

The successful candidate will be responsible for monitoring outstanding clinical documentation, following up with therapists and clinical staff, and ensuring that required session notes, records and administrative tasks are completed accurately and on time.

This role requires someone who is comfortable following up consistently with staff, managing outstanding tasks and maintaining accountability while communicating professionally and respectfully.

This is not a traditional clinical or compliance officer position. It is a hands-on coordination role that supports clinical operations by keeping documentation up to date, resolving outstanding items and ensuring that important follow-ups do not fall through the cracks.

Previous experience in healthcare administration, clinical operations, quality assurance, scheduling, staff coordination or a similar environment would be highly beneficial.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Documentation & Compliance Follow-Up

  • Monitor outstanding clinical documentation, including session notes and other required records.
  • Follow up with therapists and clinical staff regarding incomplete, overdue or missing documentation.
  • Track outstanding tasks and ensure they are completed within the required timeframes.
  • Identify recurring documentation issues and escalate concerns when necessary.
  • Ensure clinical records and administrative information are maintained accurately and consistently.
  • Support adherence to internal processes, documentation requirements and operational deadlines.

Staff Communication & Accountability

  • Communicate regularly with Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs), Behavior Technicians (BTs), Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) and other relevant team members.
  • Follow up on outstanding tasks through appropriate communication channels, including email, messaging platforms and telephone calls.
  • Maintain a professional, respectful and supportive communication style, even when repeated follow-ups are required.
  • Build positive working relationships while ensuring staff remain accountable for completing required tasks.
  • Respond to queries, clarify outstanding requirements and help staff understand what needs to be completed.
  • Escalate persistent non-compliance or unresolved issues to the relevant team lead or manager.

Session Tracking & Operational Support

  • Monitor session documentation and session conversion to identify outstanding or incomplete items.
  • Track missing notes, incomplete records and other operational requirements.
  • Follow up with relevant staff to resolve discrepancies and outstanding items.
  • Maintain accurate trackers, reports and system records to monitor progress.
  • Work closely with clinical, scheduling and operations teams to resolve bottlenecks.
  • Identify patterns in recurring delays and recommend practical improvements to follow-up processes.

Reporting & Performance Monitoring

  • Maintain clear records of outstanding tasks, follow-ups, completion rates and unresolved issues.
  • Provide regular updates on documentation completion and outstanding compliance-related requirements.
  • Monitor deadlines and ensure overdue items receive appropriate attention.
  • Highlight recurring issues, workflow challenges and areas requiring additional support.
  • Help maintain an organised, accountable and efficient clinical operations environment.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in healthcare administration, clinical operations, medical administration, quality assurance, scheduling, staff coordination or a similar role.
  • Experience following up with employees, healthcare professionals or operational teams on outstanding tasks.
  • Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Confidence in making follow-up calls and sending reminders when tasks remain incomplete.
  • Ability to maintain accountability without being confrontational or making colleagues feel undermined.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and resolve outstanding issues.
  • Ability to manage multiple follow-ups, deadlines and priorities simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, trackers, documentation systems and reporting tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable home-office setup.
  • Willingness to work hours aligned with US business operations.

Highly Advantageous

  • Previous experience in ABA, behavioural health, therapy services or a healthcare environment.
  • Familiarity with RBTs, BTs, BCBAs or other clinical professionals.
  • Experience with clinical session notes, treatment documentation or healthcare records.
  • Experience monitoring documentation completion, compliance requirements or quality standards.
  • Experience using electronic health records (EHRs), clinical management platforms, CRMs or similar systems.
  • Previous experience in a team lead, senior administrator, quality assurance or clinical coordination role.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is proactive, dependable and comfortable taking ownership of outstanding tasks. The ideal candidate understands that effective follow-up requires consistency, professionalism and good relationship management.

You should be able to remind people of their responsibilities, manage recurring follow-ups and escalate unresolved issues appropriately without creating unnecessary frustration or conflict.

If you are highly organised, detail-oriented and enjoy helping teams stay on track, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Patient Reported Outcomes
jobs.excerpt: BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals.
jobs.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:


The Senior Director, Patient Reported Outcomes (PRO), is a senior scientific and strategic leader accountable for developing and executing integrated evidence-generation strategies that demonstrate the humanistic value of BeOne Medicines therapies. The role provides enterprise-level PRO leadership across one or more assets, indications, therapeutic areas, or regions and ensures that high-priority evidence needs are represented in integrated evidence plans, medical strategies, clinical development plans, and value and access strategies. The Senior Director influences portfolio and asset decisions, leads complex global humanistic programs, governs scientific quality and investment, and builds organizational capability through people leadership, matrix leadership, and external scientific engagement.


Working across Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Global Value, Access and Pricing, Biostatistics, Data Science, Patient-Reported Outcomes, Regulatory, Safety, Publications, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, and regional teams, the incumbent translates evidence gaps into prioritized, feasible research programs. The role is accountable for strategic alignment, scientific rigor, compliant execution, timely delivery, budget stewardship, and effective communication of PRO evidence to internal decision-makers and appropriate external stakeholders.



Essential Functions of the Job:


Strategy and Portfolio Leadership

  • Own and provide senior leadership for global or regional PRO strategy across assigned assets, programs, therapeutic areas, or portfolios throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Shape integrated evidence plans by identifying, prioritizing, and revisiting evidence gaps in collaboration with cross-functional leadership and evidence-generating functions.
  • Ensure PRO perspectives are incorporated into asset strategy, clinical development plans, medical plans, lifecycle planning, launch preparation, reimbursement strategy, and annual operating and budget processes.
  • Advise senior leaders and governance bodies on PRO evidence priorities, investment trade-offs, methodological options, feasibility, timing, and risk.
  • Anticipate changes in healthcare systems, payer and health technology assessment expectations, data availability, methodological standards, and the competitive landscape, and translate those changes into strategic recommendations.

Scientific and Methodological Leadership

  • Provide executive scientific oversight for PRO real-world evidence, observational research, comparative effectiveness and safety research, burden-of-illness studies, patient preference research, health economic models, indirect treatment comparisons, evidence syntheses, and value communication deliverables.
  • Guide the selection and implementation of fit-for-purpose patient-reported outcome and other clinical outcome assessment strategies in partnership with PRO and Clinical Development experts.
  • Ensure research questions, protocols, analysis plans, models, and interpretations are scientifically rigorous, reproducible, transparent, and aligned with intended decision needs.
  • Provide senior review and approval, within delegated authority, of concepts, protocols, statistical analysis plans, technical reports, models, publications, and executive presentations.
  • Sponsor innovation in PRO, analytical, and data-science methods while ensuring appropriate validation, governance, and business relevance.

Program Governance and Execution

  • Lead a portfolio of complex, high-impact evidence-generation programs from concept through results dissemination and project closure.
  • Set priorities, decision rights, milestones, quality expectations, and escalation pathways for internal teams and external research partners.
  • Oversee project budgets, forecasts, contracts, vendor performance, timelines, risks, and resource allocation, and take timely corrective action when objectives are at risk.
  • Ensure appropriate cross-functional review and compliance with applicable legal, ethical, privacy, safety, regulatory, publication, data-governance, and company requirements.
  • Establish fit-for-purpose quality controls and independent technical review for complex analyses, models, and high-impact deliverables.
  • Ensure balanced interpretation of findings, including uncertainty, missingness, bias, confounding, generalizability, sensitivity analyses, and study limitations.

Cross-Functional and Executive Influence

  • Serve as the senior PRO partner to asset teams, medical and development leadership, access teams, governance committees, and regional stakeholders.
  • Build alignment across functions and geographies when priorities, evidence needs, timelines, or methodological perspectives differ.
  • Translate complex scientific and economic evidence into clear implications and recommendations for executive, clinical, payer, regulatory, and nontechnical audiences.
  • Facilitate timely decisions by framing options, trade-offs, dependencies, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Contribute to business development, due diligence, portfolio assessment, and external partnership evaluations, as assigned.
  • Lead or oversee publication and scientific communication strategies for assigned PRO programs in partnership with Publications and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Represent BeOne Medicines at scientific congresses, professional associations, advisory forums, and other appropriate external engagements.
  • Build credible relationships with researchers, clinicians, payers, health economists, patient organizations, and other external experts in accordance with company policies.
  • Advance the company’s scientific reputation through high-quality research, peer-reviewed publications, presentations, and responsible methodological leadership.

People and Organizational Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop direct reports and provide matrix leadership to cross-functional colleagues, contractors, and external research teams.
  • Set clear objectives, provide actionable feedback, support development planning, and create an inclusive environment that promotes accountability, collaboration, and scientific challenge.
  • Assess capability and capacity needs and recommend hiring, external support, training, tools, standards, and operating-model improvements.
  • Promote consistent PRO practices, knowledge sharing, reusable resources, and continuous improvement across global and regional teams.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment, integrity, financial stewardship, and accountability for decisions and commitments.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Manages and develops one or more employees, as assigned, and provides senior functional direction to matrix teams, contractors, and external research partners.
  • Accountable for goal setting, performance and development discussions, workload prioritization, succession and capability planning, and a respectful, inclusive team environment.

Education Required:

  • Advanced degree in health economics, outcomes research, epidemiology, biostatistics, public health, psychometrics, pharmacy, medicine, or a related quantitative or clinical discipline, or equivalent education and relevant experience.

Required Qualifications:

  • Advanced Degree (Masters, PhD, PharmD, PhD, MD) with 10 or more years of progressively responsible experience in PRO, RWE, outcomes research, epidemiology, market access evidence, medical affairs, clinical research, or a related field, including substantial biopharmaceutical or healthcare-sector experience.
  • Demonstrated success defining and executing evidence strategies for complex assets, therapeutic areas, or portfolios in a global or multi-regional environment.
  • Deep expertise in several relevant methods, including observational study design, causal inference, comparative effectiveness, economic modeling, indirect treatment comparisons, evidence synthesis, PRO/COA methods, patient preference research, or analysis of claims, electronic health records, registries, or clinical-trial data.
  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders, governance bodies, and cross-functional teams without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Demonstrated leadership of complex programs, budgets, vendors, risks, competing priorities, people, and matrix teams.
  • Strong scientific communication record and excellent written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Working knowledge of applicable research, privacy, safety, publication, compliance, and data-governance expectations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Doctoral degree in a relevant discipline.
  • Significant oncology and hematology experience.
  • Experience with health technology assessment, reimbursement, regulatory, or value communication strategies across major global markets.
  • Demonstrated publication record and external scientific presence in PRO, epidemiology, health economics, or related methods.
  • Experience establishing functional standards, governance, centers of excellence, or enterprise-wide evidence-generation capabilities.
  • Experience with statistical or analytical software and critical review of code outputs, models, data specifications, tables, and figures.

Computer Skills:

  • PC, including MS Office Suite and MS Teams.
  • Proficiency with productivity, collaboration, presentation, project-management, and document-management platforms.
  • Familiarity with analytical tools, real-world data sources, economic-modeling applications, literature-review platforms, or regulated content systems is preferred.

Travel:

  • Approximately 25–30%, including domestic and international travel as business needs require.
  • Ability to participate in meetings across time zones and respond flexibly to critical business needs.
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the role with or without reasonable accommodation.

Additional Position Information:

  • Reports to the Vice President, Integrative Evidence Generation and Health Economics, Global Medical Affairs.
  • Work location: Remote.
  • People-manager role with direct reports and/or matrix leadership, as assigned.

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity

jobs.description:
Work Remotely. Create Your Own Schedule. Help CDL Drivers Find Their Next Opportunity.

We are looking for motivated individuals to join our team as independent truck driver recruiters!

Our recruiting team works with established trucking carriers throughout the United States, helping connect qualified CDL drivers with driving opportunities that match their experience, location, and career preferences.

As a recruiter, you will communicate with prospective drivers, learn about their qualifications and employment needs, and help guide them through the application and placement process.

This is a remote, 1099 independent contractor opportunity offering the flexibility to create your own schedule while building your recruiting business with access to training, resources, and ongoing support.

A background in recruiting and/or truck driving is helpful but not required. We welcome individuals who are new to the industry and motivated to learn!

What You'll Do

  • Connect with CDL drivers who are exploring new employment opportunities.
  • Learn about each driver's experience, qualifications, location, and preferred type of driving position.
  • Match qualified drivers with available opportunities through our partner trucking carriers.
  • Explain position details, answer questions, and assist interested drivers with the application process.
  • Follow up with applicants throughout the recruiting and hiring process.
  • Maintain accurate applicant information and track recruiting activity.
  • Build and manage your own pipeline of prospective drivers.

Compensation & Independent Contractor Status

This is a 1099 independent contractor position with commission-only compensation. It is NOT an hourly or salaried position.

Recruiters earn commissions when they successfully place qualified drivers with our partner trucking carriers, subject to the applicable commission agreement and payment terms.

Please understand the following before applying:

  • There is no guaranteed hourly pay, salary, or minimum income.
  • Commissions are earned through successful driver placements, not simply by contacting drivers or submitting applications.
  • A driver must meet the applicable placement requirements for a commission to become payable.
  • Commissions are paid according to the applicable commission agreement and payment schedule.
  • Taxes are not withheld from contractor payments. Recruiters are responsible for their own applicable taxes and tax obligations.
  • Your first placement and commission may take time. Immediate earnings are not guaranteed.

Applicants must be comfortable with the 1099 independent contractor structure and commission-only compensation to be considered for this opportunity.

Create Your Own Schedule | Start Part-Time & Grow

One of the benefits of independent recruiting is the flexibility to create your own schedule and build your recruiting business at a pace that works for you.

This opportunity can be a great fit for individuals looking to start part-time and work toward supplemental income while learning the recruiting process.

As you gain experience, build your driver pipeline, and develop your recruiting skills, you have the flexibility to dedicate more time to recruiting and potentially transition to full-time independent work.

Whether you choose to recruit part-time or dedicate more time to building your business, consistency and follow-through are important.

Building relationships with drivers, maintaining an active pipeline, and following up on applications all contribute to creating opportunities for successful placements.

The more time and effort you invest in developing your recruiting business, the more opportunities you may create for successful placements. However, commissions and earnings are never guaranteed.

Training & Ongoing Support

Previous recruiting or truck-driving experience is helpful, but it is not required!

Whether you have experience in recruiting, have worked in the trucking industry, or are completely new to both, we provide introductory training and resources to help you learn the recruiting process.

Training includes:

  • Understanding the basics of CDL driver recruiting and common driver qualifications
  • Learning about available driving opportunities and carrier requirements
  • Identifying suitable positions based on a driver's experience, location, and preferences
  • Communicating professionally with prospective drivers
  • Guiding interested drivers through the application process
  • Organizing recruiting activity and managing applicant follow-up

New recruiters receive guidance on getting started, along with access to recruiting resources and ongoing support.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently and stay organized
  • Comfortable communicating with prospective drivers by phone, text, and other approved recruiting channels
  • Willingness to learn the trucking industry and driver qualification requirements
  • Ability to follow up consistently and maintain accurate applicant records
  • Basic computer skills and reliable internet access
  • A professional, dependable approach to working with applicants
  • Self-motivation and a willingness to invest time in building a recruiting pipeline

A background in recruiting, truck driving, sales, or customer service is a plus, but no previous experience is required.

Interested in Becoming a Truck Driver Recruiter?

If you enjoy connecting with people, want the flexibility of independent work, and are comfortable building a commission-based recruiting business, we would love to hear from you!

Whether you're interested in starting part-time for potential supplemental income or eventually pursuing recruiting on a full-time basis, we provide the training and resources to help you get started.

Apply today to learn more about our recruiting opportunity, training process, and how to get started.

Please note: This is a remote, commission-only 1099 independent contractor opportunity. No hourly pay, salary, or guaranteed earnings are provided.

Salary: $25,000 – $70,000 / year

Job Description

A bit about this role:

The Payment Integrity Inpatient Program Manager is responsible for overseeing assigned inpatient Payment Integrity programs, including audit, appeals, quality, and review processes across internal teams, offshore staff augmentation, and external vendors. This role is heavily focused on ensuring audit accuracy, timeliness, coding and clinical quality, regulatory compliance, consistency, and defensibility across all assigned program areas. The Program Manager is accountable not only for the quality of audit determinations but also for ensuring audits are reviewed within SLA and that inventory is actively managed to prevent backlogs.

The Program Manager partners closely with leadership and operational support teams to ensure audit workflows are executed effectively and on time while maintaining strong oversight of audit quality, turnaround performance, dispute outcomes, vendor performance, and adherence to organizational and regulatory standards.


Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Perform complex and escalated inpatient Payment Integrity audits, including clinical validation, DRG coding validation, readmission, and hospital bill audit reviews, and provide clear, defensible audit rationale and determinations.
  • Provide guidance and oversight to internal staff (offshore and stateside)) and external vendors, managing calibration sessions, feedback loops, education, and ongoing quality monitoring to ensure compliance and adherence to program expectations
  • Develop and maintain program-specific training materials, audit guidance, review standards, and supporting documentation
  • Perform quality reviews and trend analysis to ensure coding, clinical, and audit findings are accurate, defensible, and aligned with regulatory, contractual, and organizational requirements
  • Monitor program metrics, dispute trends, and vendor results, partnering with leadership to identify root causes, address quality concerns, and drive continuous improvement efforts
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve complex audit, coding, clinical, and escalation-related issues, serving as the primary subject matter expert for assigned program areas
  • Support dispute and appeals management activities, including escalation review, audit rationale review, and corrective action planning
  • Support the implementation of new audit concepts, review methodologies, and program enhancements to align with evolving business and regulatory needs

Required skills and experience:

  • 2-3 years of experience in healthcare audit, Payment Integrity, coding review, clinical documentation review, or compliance
  • Strong clinical and inpatient coding knowledge required; CCS, RHIA, RHIT, RN, or equivalent inpatient coding/clinical validation experience required. Demonstrated expertise in inpatient DRG coding and validation strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience with inpatient DRG assignment and validation, including ICD-10-CM coding, principal and secondary diagnosis assignment, MCC/CC identification, POA indicators, and inpatient clinical documentation review, as well as severity of illness/risk of mortality concepts and readmission logic.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing medical records to ensure audit accuracy, coding/clinical correctness, compliance, and defensibility of determinations
  • Experience operating within structured audit programs, including applying defined criteria, documenting rationale, and ensuring consistency and quality of audit outcomes
  • Ability to interpret clinical and/or coding documentation to support audit decisions and resolve documentation gaps or discrepancies
  • Experience collaborating across clinical, coding, audit, and operational teams in a complex healthcare environment
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess audit trends, root causes, and documentation gaps impacting program performance and quality outcomes
  • Strong operational discipline and the ability to stay organized amidst a wide variety of responsibilities
  • Proven experience in training payment integrity audits

Desired skills and experience:

  • Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to effectively engage internal and external stakeholders

Early in the program, you will own key workstreams on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions while collaborating with team members at all levels of Veeva. You will be given the tools and resources to accelerate your consulting skills development.

Our Business Consulting team builds effective business and operational improvement strategies powered by Veeva’s unique industry insights, and market-leading technology. Our offerings are focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers.

If you’re graduating with an advanced degree or have 3-5 years of industry experience and are excited to pivot your career into consulting for a critical industry, Master Class is for you.

Position:

Global Microsoft GTM LEAD

Job Description:

As the Global Microsoft GTM Lead, you are responsible for orchestrating Arrow's Microsoft go-to-market execution globally. You translate the strategic direction set by the Global Director of Hyperscalers into a concrete, prioritised and actionable plan across global leads, regions and countries.

You are the daily connection point between Microsoft stakeholders and Arrow's internal teams. Your role is to ensure that Microsoft priorities, programs, investments and strategic initiatives are clearly understood, structured, communicated and executed across the organisation.

You also act as the internal reference point for Microsoft-related topics — helping teams navigate priorities, align on messaging, resolve questions, connect the right stakeholders, and ensure that execution remains consistent across geographies.


Key responsibilities


  • Own the global Microsoft GTM operating rhythm in alignment with the Global Director of Hyperscalers, translating strategic priorities into a clear execution plan for global leads, regions and countries.
  • Manage and coordinate the team of global leads by setting priorities, structuring follow-up, ensuring alignment across workstreams, and helping remove blockers to execution.
  • Drive the daily relationship with Microsoft stakeholders by acting as Arrow's central point of contact for ongoing business priorities, program alignment, investment discussions and joint execution topics.
  • Be the go-to person internally for Microsoft-related topics by guiding teams on priorities, messaging, escalation paths, stakeholder engagement and ownership of key initiatives.
  • Translate Microsoft priorities into Arrow-ready motions by turning vendor programs, campaigns and strategic initiatives into practical frameworks that countries and partners can activate.
  • Connect global strategy with local execution by ensuring that country and regional teams understand the priorities, have the right tools, and are supported through launch, follow-up and adoption.
  • Ensure alignment across functions including sales, marketing, operations, enablement, partner programs, vendor management and regional leadership.
  • Build repeatable GTM frameworks and playbooks that make it easier for Arrow teams to execute Microsoft motions consistently across markets.
  • Track execution and business impact by following up on key initiatives, consolidating progress, identifying gaps and preparing decision-ready updates for leadership.
  • Support executive communication and governance by preparing clear summaries, business updates, stakeholder briefings and recommendations for internal and Microsoft-facing discussions.

Example initiatives you will build

Concrete examples of the kind of motions, frameworks and operating models you will design and roll out:

  • Global Microsoft GTM operating rhythm — a structured cadence to align global leads, country teams and Microsoft stakeholders on priorities, progress and decisions.
  • Microsoft stakeholder engagement model — a clear map of key Microsoft contacts, ownership, escalation paths and engagement routines.
  • Global leads governance framework — a practical model to define ownership, priorities, follow-up and accountability across Microsoft-related initiatives.
  • Country activation playbooks — repeatable frameworks that help local teams land Microsoft priorities consistently and faster.
  • Microsoft priority tracker — a central view of key programs, campaigns, investments, blockers and next steps across regions.
  • Executive business review materials — concise, decision-ready updates for internal leadership and Microsoft stakeholders.
  • Internal Microsoft knowledge hub — a structured source of truth for programs, priorities, contacts, messaging and GTM resources.

Required experience & skills


  • Strong understanding of the Microsoft ecosystem and of how a value-added distributor operates, including partner models, channel dynamics, incentives, programs and vendor engagement.
  • Experience managing go-to-market execution across multiple countries, regions or business units.
  • Proven ability to manage senior stakeholders, both internally and externally, in a complex international organisation.
  • Experience leading or coordinating cross-functional teams, workstreams or global leads without relying only on direct authority.
  • Strong programme and project management skills, with the ability to structure priorities, track execution, follow up rigorously and keep multiple initiatives moving in parallel.
  • Ability to translate strategic vendor priorities into practical commercial motions, frameworks, enablement assets and execution plans.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics and create clear, executive-ready updates.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and alignment across teams is critical.

Key competencies


  • Highly structured and organised — keeps multiple stakeholders, countries, workstreams and follow-ups moving without losing momentum.
  • Strong stakeholder manager — builds trust with Microsoft, internal leadership, global leads and country teams.
  • Strategic yet execution-focused — understands the big picture but is hands-on in turning strategy into operating rhythm, playbooks and results.
  • Commercially sharp — understands how GTM priorities translate into sales execution, partner activation and business impact.
  • Collaborative and influential — able to align teams across functions and geographies, even when priorities or ownership are complex.
  • Proactive problem-solver — anticipates blockers, clarifies ownership and drives issues to resolution.
  • Confident communicator — able to represent Arrow internally and externally with clarity, professionalism and credibility.
  • Autonomous and accountable — self-driven, reliable and comfortable operating in a high-visibility global role while aligning closely with the Global Director of Hyperscalers.

What We Offer


  • Competitive compensation (base + variable).
  • Supportive work environment with flat structures.
  • Company Car or Car Allowance
  • Professional and personal development opportunities.
  • Private healthcare and other benefits.

Senior Technical Customer Success Manager

This role is eligible for full-time remote employment within the US or can be hybrid in our Durham, NC office 2-3 days/week. Please note that we unfortunately cannot sponsor H1B visas at this time. Arpio participates in the US Government's eVerify Program.

Who We Are

Modern enterprises run their most critical applications in complex, cloud-native environments, and the threats keep multiplying: outages, ransomware, bad actors, human error. Most disaster recovery tools stop at backing up data. We’ve built the next generation of cloud resiliency and disaster recovery for AWS and Azure with an automated, application-aware platform that recovers a company's entire application stack, not isolated resources, in under an hour. We protect production workloads for enterprises that cut across multiple industries like healthcare, financial services, and SaaS - the kind of companies that can't afford downtime.

At Arpio, we believe great companies are built by people who take ownership, move with urgency, and consistently deliver results. We just closed our $15M Series A to expand into new clouds and build out our roadmap, which means we're growing the team right now, and your work will directly shape where we go next.

This isn't simply another job. It's an opportunity to help build a company.

About the Role

Our Customer Success team helps Arpio customers protect their applications from the unexpected, using Arpio’s innovative SaaS platform. As a Senior Technical Customer Success Manager, you will serve as an integral part of our growing team, focusing on customer satisfaction and retention for large enterprise organizations.

In this role, you will establish yourself as a trusted partner to our enterprise customers throughout their lifecycle with Arpio. You will report to the Head of Customer Success to track customer goals & health, and partner with a Solution Engineer to navigate complex implementations.

What You'll Do

  • Lead implementation and onboarding processes with customers, using Customer Success best practices to document and accelerate onboarding and migration plans
  • Track time to value and success metrics for Arpio customers
  • Proactively monitor customer health to identify potential risks and areas of opportunity to optimize customer usage and drive adoption
  • Lead quarterly business reviews with customers to share product updates and drive renewals and expansion
  • Collaborate with engineers to triage and troubleshoot technical issues, ensuring timely resolution for customer-reported issues
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to share customer feedback and act as a customer advocate for product improvements, as well as new features and requirements

How We Work

At Arpio, we care about the outcome as much as the effort it took to get there. We take initiative, follow through, and report back on what we learned along the way. That same instinct shows up in how we treat customers and each other: we respond quickly, speak honestly and openly, and trust our teammates to take direct feedback as a chance to grow. We move like a startup because we are one, spending wisely and treating every dollar and every customer like they matter, because they do. If that's how you like to work, you'll fit in well here. For this role, that looks like:

  • Owning the outcome, not just the ticket. You measure success by whether your customer can recover their applications when it matters. That means driving implementations to a tested, working recovery plan, not just a completed setup, and closing the loop with the customer and our team on what you learned.
  • Being fast and candid with customers. When something breaks or a risk shows up in a customer's account, you raise it quickly and give them the real picture, even when it's not what they want to hear. Enterprise customers trust us with their production workloads, and that trust comes from honesty.
  • Treating every account like it matters, because it does. You find practical ways to drive adoption and expansion without waiting for a perfect playbook. You turn customer feedback into clear, prioritized input for Product and Engineering, and you're open to direct feedback on your own work.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing Customer Success or Account Management role
  • Previous experience using CSM tools such as SalesForce, Hubspot, Intercom, etc. and ticketing tools such as Jira
  • Strong understanding of AWS and/or Azure services, cloud computing and networking technologies, and a desire to continue to learn new technologies
  • Excellent communication skills with a proven ability to collaborate and build relationships with customers
  • Keen attention to detail, as well as the ability to also see the bigger picture and identify opportunities for improvement
  • Curious and capable problem solving skills
  • Enthusiasm for working at an early stage company and diving in to take on the challenges and opportunities involved

Salary and Benefits

For your dependents, Arpio will cover 75% of medical, dental, and vision premiums. No life insurance is included.

jobs.excerpt: About GoChartingGoCharting is a web-native charting and trading workflow platform with institutional-grade orderflow and DOM tools — footprint/cluster charts, volume/market profile, cumulative delta, imbalance charts, DOM trading.
jobs.description:
About GoCharting

GoCharting is a web-native charting and trading workflow platform with institutional-grade orderflow and DOM tools — footprint/cluster charts, volume/market profile, cumulative delta, imbalance charts, DOM trading. We are the only platform that delivers these capabilities fully on the web. Comparable to TradingView for general charting, but differentiated as the leader in the professional orderflow niche. PE-acquired and funded in 2025, profitable, 3M+ registered traders globally, with a mandate to scale 10x over 4 years.

The Role

This is the most consequential backend role we are hiring this year. GoCharting runs a freemium subscription business across two payment gateways (Stripe and Razorpay), two legal entities (US and India), and multiple currencies — and the systems that move money, grant entitlements, and report revenue have grown organically to the point where they need to be rebuilt properly. Subscriptions and resubscriptions don't always renew cleanly, some captured payments never become entitlements, refunds and disputes aren't fully handled, and the data we need for exchange reporting, accounting close, and conversion/retention analysis has to be reconstructed by hand.

You will own the fix. Working from an existing target design — a journals-as-truth billing and entitlement ledger — you will build the canonical payments, subscription, entitlement, and user-billing platform from the ground up and migrate the live business onto it without dropping a rupee or a dollar. This is the financial heartbeat of the company: no payment is correct, no entitlement is granted, and no month closes cleanly without the system you build. You report to the CTO inside Core Platform Engineering and work in lockstep with Finance and the COO, who own the design and the accounting/reporting requirements.

In year one, success looks like: every captured payment producing exactly one ledger entry and the right entitlement; subscriptions and resubscriptions renewing, upgrading, and lapsing correctly across both gateways; refunds, disputes, and proration handled in code; and clean, trustworthy data flowing to accounting, exchange reporting, and the growth team — with the legacy account model retired behind the new one.

What you'll do

  • Build the canonical billing & entitlement ledger — design and implement an append-only, journals-as-truth Postgres schema (orders, signed payments ledger, dated entitlement grants, gap-free per-entity invoice numbering) where all state is a derived view and every entitlement traces to a paid order line
  • Own the full subscription lifecycle in code — purchase, renewal, resubscription, upgrade/downgrade/switch, proration, trials, cancellation, and lapse — across both Stripe and Razorpay, ending the renewal/resubscription bugs that lose money and entitlements today
  • Build the gateway ingest pipeline — idempotent, replay-safe webhook handling for Stripe, Razorpay, and Apple notifications, normalized into the ledger with dead-letter handling and reconciliation that proves the gateway and our books agree every day
  • Handle the hard money paths — refunds, chargebacks/disputes, credits, and partial/zero-amount settlements, with signed lines that allocate the gateway-charged amount correctly and never double-count
  • Produce clean financial & entitlement data — the views that feed accounting close (revenue recognition, multi-entity GST/IGST and US tax, deferred revenue), exchange reporting (CME and Indian exchanges), and conversion/retention analytics
  • Own the user billing surface end-to-end — the user cabinet and checkout (TypeScript/Astro/React) where customers buy, upgrade, manage, and cancel — so the experience and the ledger never disagree
  • Migrate the live business safely — backfill historical payments with documented confidence tiers, run the new system in parallel against the legacy CouchDB account model, prove reconciliation is clean, then cut over read and write paths region by region

What we're looking for

Must-haves:

  • 6–10 years backend engineering, with deep Go and strong relational data-modelling and SQL — you design schemas that stay correct under concurrency and scale
  • You have built or rebuilt payments, subscriptions, and ledgers end-to-end — payment-gateway integration, idempotent webhooks, the subscription lifecycle (renewals, proration, upgrades, cancellation, dunning), and refunds and disputes — this is the core of the job, not an adjacent skill
  • The full money-systems depth that surrounds a ledger is required, not optional: reconciliation (gateway ↔ books), revenue recognition and tax (e.g. GST/IGST, ASC 606 or equivalent), financial/exchange reporting, and event-sourced / append-only ledger design (journals-as-truth, derived state, signed entries)
  • Experience building or owning a B2B product where billing and entitlement complexity is real (metering, plans/add-ons, multi-tenant or partner billing) — GoCharting also runs a /b2b and white-label surface
  • SQL fluency to interrogate money data yourself — you can find the row that explains the discrepancy, not just file a ticket
  • Comfortable in a TypeScript/React frontend to own the user cabinet and checkout end-to-end (you don't need to be a frontend specialist, but you ship the surface that touches your ledger)
  • In-person in our Chennai office — this role works too closely with Finance, the CTO, and the live money flow to be remote

Nice-to-haves:

  • Prior fintech or trading domain — genuinely good to have, but not required: billing correctness is domain-agnostic and the markets context is learnable on the job
  • EU VAT/OSS, multi-entity, or multi-currency billing experience
  • AWS Cognito / identity at scale, or prior work untangling a legacy data model during a live migration
  • Experience standing up reconciliation, finance-close, or revenue-reporting pipelines that accountants actually trusted

Logistics

Location Remote ( Europe based )

Employment type Full-Time

Travel Minimal

Start date ASAP

Reports to Ragunath Ramaswamy, CTO (Core Platform Engineering)

jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

jobs.description:
Engagement type: Independent contractor or travel management company

Location: Remote; provider must be able to support U.S.-based travelers

Initial term: One year, with the possibility of renewal

1. Organization Profile

NESsT is an international nonprofit organization operating across Latin America, Central and Eastern Europe, and the United States. NESsT invests in social enterprises that create dignified employment and sustainable income opportunities for people facing barriers to economic inclusion, while contributing to environmental sustainability. Through business support, catalytic capital, and long-term partnerships, NESsT helps social enterprises grow their impact and strengthen local economies.

2. Objective of the Engagement

The objective of this engagement is to establish a reliable travel management service that supports NESsT’s U.S.-based staff with domestic and international travel arrangements while ensuring traveler safety, operational efficiency, policy compliance, and prudent stewardship of organizational and donor resources.

4. Scope of Services

The selected provider will coordinate flights, accommodations, travel insurance, itineraries, booking changes, cancellations, and travel-related support for authorized NESsT travelers.

4.1 Air Travel

The provider will:

  • Research and present flight options that balance price, total travel time, number of connections, and traveler convenience.
  • Prioritize the most economical option that reasonably minimizes travel time and unnecessary connections.
  • Recommend fully or partially refundable tickets when the additional cost does not exceed approximately 30% of the ticket price.
  • Manage ticket issuance, schedule changes, rebookings, cancellations, and refund requests.
  • Monitor significant itinerary changes and promptly notify the traveler and designated NESsT contact.

4.2 Accommodation

The provider will:

  • Source and book practical, well-rated, and cost-effective accommodations close to the relevant event venue, office, or meeting location.
  • Generally propose hotels of up to three stars for single occupancy and four stars for double.
  • Keep hotel rates within NESsT’s approved travel limits (below 60% of the applicable U.S. Department of State foreign per diem lodging rate for the destination).
  • Clearly identify cancellation terms, taxes, fees, and any non-refundable conditions before booking.

4.3 Travel Insurance

  • Recommend appropriate insurance options for the destination and travel circumstances.
  • Present several alternatives when feasible, with a clear comparison of coverage, exclusions, and price.
  • Arrange coverage that includes, at a minimum, medical treatment for illness arising during travel, accidents requiring medical assistance, baggage loss, and expenses related to flight delays.
  • Issue and provide the relevant policy documentation before departure.

4.4 Traveler Support

The provider will:

  • Serve as the primary travel coordination contact before and during each trip.
  • Prepare and share clear itineraries and booking confirmations.
  • Assist with delays, cancellations, missed connections, and other disruptions.
  • Offer a clear escalation channel for urgent assistance outside standard business hours.

4.5 Billing and Administration

NESsT prefers periodic, consolidated invoicing and payment by bank transfer rather than payment by corporate credit card. The provider will:

  • Confirm its ability to invoice NESsT and accept payment by bank transfer.
  • Provide itemized invoices showing the traveler, itinerary, base cost, taxes, fees, service charges, credits, and refunds.
  • Provide supporting documentation for each transaction.
  • Maintain accurate records of bookings, changes, cancellations, credits, and unused tickets.
  • Coordinate with NESsT’s Operations and Finance teams on documentation and payment matters.

5. Provider Qualifications

Applicants should demonstrate:

  • At least three years of experience providing corporate or business travel management services.
  • Substantial experience arranging international travel.
  • Knowledge of airline fare structures, ticketing rules, refunds, exchanges, and travel logistics.
  • Experience arranging accommodations and travel insurance across multiple destinations.
  • The ability to support senior executives and frequent travelers.
  • Strong customer service, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
  • The systems and capacity to manage multiple concurrent travel requests accurately.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

Experience supporting nonprofit, international development, consulting, or other mission-driven organizations, and experience coordinating travel in Latin America and Europe, are preferred.

6. Contract Management

The provider will coordinate primarily with NESsT’s designated Operations contact and with authorized travelers. NESsT anticipates an initial one-year agreement, subject to satisfactory performance, continued organizational need, and mutual agreement. The final agreement will define applicable fees, invoicing arrangements, service standards, confidentiality obligations, data protection requirements, and termination provisions.

This Terms of Reference does not guarantee a minimum number or value of bookings. NESsT may modify the scope of services or discontinue the selection process at its discretion.

7. Submission Requirements

Interested companies or independent consultants should submit a concise proposal containing:

  • Provider profile: Legal name, location, years in operation, organizational structure, and primary contact details.
  • Relevant experience: Description of comparable corporate or international travel assignments, including experience supporting nonprofit or mission-driven organizations where applicable.
  • Service model: Booking workflow, approval process, communication channels, designated account support, backup coverage, and emergency support arrangements.
  • Service levels: Standard and urgent response times, hours of coverage, and escalation process.
  • Technology and reporting: Booking, traveler-profile, invoicing, expense-documentation, and reporting capabilities.
  • Financial proposal: All service, transaction, emergency, cancellation, change, implementation, and other applicable fees, together with invoicing terms and available payment methods.
  • Billing confirmation: Explicit confirmation of whether the provider can offer periodic invoicing and accept payment by bank transfer.
  • References: Contact details for three current or recent clients for comparable services.

8. Evaluation Criteria

Submissions will be assessed against the following criteria:

  • Relevant experience and qualifications.
  • Understanding of NESsT’s requirements.
  • Quality, practicality, and reliability of the proposed service model.
  • Responsiveness, traveler support, and emergency coverage.
  • Ability to provide transparent, invoice-based billing and accept payment by bank transfer.
  • Cost and overall value.
  • Quality of references.

9. Submission Instructions

Proposals should be submitted electronically in PDF format with the subject line Travel Management Services – Proposal.

Submission deadline: Oct 30, 2026

10. Equal Opportunity

NESsT is committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We welcome submissions from qualified businesses and consultants from diverse backgrounds and encourage participation by minority-owned, women-owned, veteran-owned, and other underrepresented businesses.

Success improves Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost by shortening the path from a data product request to a governed, usable data product.

The Data Fabric only matters if people use it, and that is what this role owns: the front door, the onboarding path, and the evidence of adoption. Marketplace and catalog ownership
