jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer / Data Scientist - Climate and Energy Policy
jobs.excerpt: Top Level Summary Planet Reimagined is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer / Data Scientist to design and build cutting-edge data systems that accelerate climate solutions across local and federal scales.
jobs.description:
Top Level Summary

Planet Reimagined is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer / Data Scientist to design and build cutting-edge data systems that accelerate climate solutions across local and federal scales. Join our mission-driven team building one of the world's first ML systems for hyper-local policy analysis and recommendations. You'll design, train, and deploy models, and build the knowledge graphs, wikis, and other structured datasets behind them, to identify successful climate interventions, predict how they adapt to new contexts, and optimize renewable energy deployment from city councils to federal land management.

About Planet Reimagined

Founded by a multi-platinum musician and a UN advocate, Planet Reimagined was built on the belief that big change happens when people act together and when that action drives shifts in policy and industry. On a mission to deliver fair solutions for people and the planet, we use an innovative action research method to incubate and scale creative solutions to our most pressing climate problems. We mobilize fans at concerts to take real-time civic action, and we help renewable energy companies access public lands once closed to them. From legislative wins to global campaigns, we turn bold ideas into action. And we’re just getting started.

About the Role

Join a team of creative problem-solvers dedicated to advancing global climate solutions. The Machine Learning Engineer / Data Scientist will build the data infrastructure powering insights for climate policy, renewable energy optimization, and scalable climate interventions. This role will work at the intersection of data engineering, AI/ML, and climate policy, developing tools to help communities and governments replicate successful climate solutions.

Responsibilities

Knowledge Systems & LLMs

  • Build LLM-powered knowledge graphs, wikis, and other structured datasets from policy documents, municipal records, community sentiment, and federal energy data, along with the human-readable layers rendered from them.
  • Develop LLM and NLP pipelines that extract policy elements, resolve entities, and link them across sources
  • Track data provenance so every policy element traces back to its source document, passage, and extraction method
  • Design human-in-the-loop workflows where policy experts validate extracted policy elements, and their corrections improve the models, scripts, and prompts
  • Construct policy timelines by extracting and ordering events to show how climate solutions unfold over time

Machine Learning & Modeling

  • Design, train, and deploy models for policy effectiveness scoring, solution replicability, and energy development potential
  • Build recommendation and graph-based models that match proven climate policies to a specific city, county, or community
  • Own the full modeling lifecycle: baselines, feature engineering, model selection, tuning, and error analysis
  • Develop evaluation frameworks to measure model, extraction, and LLM output quality against expert-validated ground truth
  • Analyse community-stentiment data to quantify support for climate policies within surveyed localities

Causal Analysis & Data Science

  • Build systems to facilitate rigorous comparative analysis, helping policy experts map when, where, and how policies succeed and identify causal dynamics that may transfer to other contexts.
  • Analyze policy timelines to measure adoption lags, implementation speed, and time to impact
  • Perform exploratory analysis and predictive modeling to find patterns in climate solution adoption and renewable energy development opportunities
  • Communicate findings through visualizations and automated reporting for climate and energy transition planning
  • Deliver insights from the analysis of interaction and call-to-action conversion data to improve in-concert advocacy efforts

MLOps & System Development

  • Build reproducible training, evaluation, and deployment pipelines with experiment tracking, versioning, and a model registry
  • Automate CI/CD for models, with validation gates and staged rollouts
  • Maintain the data pipelines and API integrations (BigQuery, Cloud Functions) that feed models from government, community, and federal data sources
  • Monitor model performance, data drift, and knowledge graph quality, with data governance for sensitive municipal data and PII.

Required Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in data science and ML engineering, preferably in GCP/AWS/Azure ecosystem
  • Strong proficiency in LLM application design, context engineering strategies, Python, and SQL
  • Hands-on experience building functional knowledge systems for LLM applications
  • Proven ability to work with varied, unstructured data sources including municipal records and reports, news coverage, video documentation, and government datasets.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to thrive in ambiguous climate policy and energy environments
  • Excellent communication skills for cross-functional collaboration with policy experts, community stakeholders, and federal planners including turning data analysis into data storytelling outputs.

Technical Skills

  • Core Stack: Python, SQL, BigQuery, GCP/AWS/Azure services
  • Data Tools: Pandas, NumPy, dbt, Apache Beam/Dataflow
  • API Development: REST APIs, government data integrations, real-time community sentiment and federal climate data augmentation
  • Infrastructure: Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, CI/CD with Cloud Build
  • Databases: BigQuery (primary), Firestore, vector databases (Vertex AI Vector Search, Pinecone)

Nice to Have

  • Background or strong interest in climate policy, municipal governance, federal land management, or energy transition planning
  • Experience with government data sources, regulatory documents, federal climate records, and civic data standards
  • Knowledge of policy analysis frameworks, community engagement measurement, and renewable energy development processes
  • Previous work in mission-driven organizations focused on local government, federal policy, or climate action

Ideal Candidate

You're a curious, adaptable engineer who gets energized by complex problems without clear solutions. You enjoy building systems from scratch, can navigate policy ambiguity with confidence, and are motivated by the potential to create tools that help communities and governments replicate successful climate solutions while optimizing renewable energy deployment. You balance technical excellence with practical climate impact, and you're excited to work at the intersection of data science, community-driven climate action, and federal energy policy.

Ready to help accelerate America's climate progress through data-driven policy solutions? We'd love to hear from you.

Salary and Benefits:

The salary range for this position is $120,000 – 150,000.

The final offer will consider factors like the candidate’s location, cost of living, and experience level.

We take a location-aware approach to compensation to ensure fairness and competitiveness across markets. For example, within the U.S., this range aligns with typical salaries for similar roles in major markets such as New York or Seattle (generally $140,000–$150,000) and mid-cost regions such as Dallas or Charlotte (typically $120,000–$130,000).

U.S.-based full-time employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans, and paid time off. Additional benefits include a remote but highly collegial working environment.

Conditions of employment include:

  • Ability to pass a background check.
  • Ability to provide 3 professional references including a recent supervisor

What you can expect from our hiring process:

  • Initial Phone Screen (15-20 mins)
  • Take home assessment
  • One-on-one session with hiring manager to review your work
  • Panel Interview with our team for you to present your work
  • Final interview with our leadership team
  • Reference checks
  • Aggressive recruitment timeline with goal of offer by December

Applications will be considered on a rolling basis with priority given to those who apply on or before October 23, 2026.

About the Role

At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.

Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.

You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.

What you'll own

    Define the future of OLX’s Group's brand ecosystem

    Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint.

  • Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards

  • Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles

  • Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries

  • Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)

  • Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets.

    • Build scalable creative systems powered by AI

    You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently.

    Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.

    You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.

    Raise the creative standard across OLX Group

    As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.

    You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.

    Translate strategy into brand experiences

    You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences.

    You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value.

    Drive adoption and influence across the organisation

    Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced.

    You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards.

    You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making.

    Mentor and elevate the craft

    As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work.

    You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation.

What we're looking for

    We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally.

    You create brands that people trust

    Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time.

    You think in systems

    You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables.

    You bring strategy to life through Design

    You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact.

    You're fluent in AI-enabled Design

    You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential.
    You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams.

    You influence without authority

    You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers.

    You bring depth of experience

    You'll likely have:

  • 10+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design

  • Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets

  • Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite

  • Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences

  • Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems

  • Deep familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows

  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

Why join OLX

    OLX operates some of the world's most recognized online marketplaces, connecting millions of people every day to buy, sell, find jobs, discover homes, and build businesses.

    As our Principal Brand Designer, you'll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of multiple global brands while defining how AI and design systems work together to create consistent, high-quality brand experiences at scale.

    This role offers the chance to influence design beyond individual projects to build the frameworks, standards, and creative vision that will guide OLX's brands for years to come.

    If you're excited by solving complex brand challenges, setting the highest creative standards, and pioneering the future of AI-enabled design, we'd love to hear from you.

Hiring Process

    We believe in a transparent and collaborative hiring process that reflects how we work as a team. Here’s what you can expect:
    First Stage
    Portfolio & Design Leadership
    This is a 90-minute session with the Hiring Manager. We’ll dive deep into your portfolio to assess your design craft, strategic thinking, systems mindset, and collaboration skills. This is also an opportunity to showcase your leadership in design and discuss how you approach complex challenges.

    Second Stage
    Multi-Brand Systems & Creative Leadership
    In this 60-minute session, you’ll meet with a senior leader from the Creative team. We’ll explore your ability to build, evolve, and govern brand systems across a complex multi-brand organization. This stage focuses on your creative leadership and how you ensure consistency and innovation across diverse brands.

    Third Stage
    Executive Partnership & Business Impact
    This 45-minute session is with a senior leader from the Marketing team. We’ll assess your leadership presence, ability to form strategic partnerships with Marketing, and your commercial thinking. This is also a chance to discuss how you drive organizational influence and deliver business impact through brand design.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

Data Process Policy

OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a mid-level Software Engineer on a contract basis to help build and extend the platforms that power our programs.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a mid-level Software Engineer on a contract basis to help build and extend the platforms that power our programs. You'll work alongside our senior engineers on well-scoped features across the stack, contributing production-quality code from early on and working with a high degree of independence as you ramp up.

About Unify America

We’re on a mission to replace political fighting with collaborative problem-solving. Yeah, we know it sounds audacious. It is. But we’re doing it—by creating civic experiences that reduce polarization, teaching essential civic skills, and inviting Americans to use their differences to better solve common problems together.

Where we work:

  • Higher Education (Civic Gym): Over 50,000 college students have engaged in meaningful cross-partisan conversations. Think of it as training for democracy—reps, sweat, and all.

  • Cities (Democracy Leagues): We partner with communities to run Civic Assemblies, where residents—across the ideological spectrum—solve shared problems together. Our first pilot is in Akron, with more locations to come.

We're a small, mission-driven team of about 30 people, and our engineering team is small enough that every engineer has a real voice in how we build. Civic Gym has a more mature technical product that our existing Dev Team is in the process of re-factoring. Democracy Leagues is just at the beginning of building a product suite to prepare us to scale our deliberative democracy work in Ohio and beyond. That’s why this is a 6 to 12 month contract gig - we’ve got a lot of immediate needs, but still have a lot to learn about what our future needs will be.

About the Role

You'll ship features end to end, shape technical decisions, set a high bar for code quality, and mentor other engineers. You'll work closely with our CTO, product manager, and program teams to turn real-world civic engagement needs into reliable, thoughtfully designed software. More specifically, you’ll:

  • Build and maintain features across our TypeScript/Node.js backend and Vue.js front end

  • Design and update data models for your features in MongoDB and PostgreSQL, with review from senior engineers

  • Work with AWS services such as Lambda, S3, Aurora, DynamoDB, and IAM in developing and deploying your work

  • Write clean, tested, maintainable code, and participate constructively in code review

  • Help build out our new civic assembly platform, including modules within a plugin-based architecture

  • Communicate progress, blockers, and questions clearly and proactively

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience

  • Solid experience with TypeScript and NodeJS

  • Experience with Django and Python

  • Experience with VueJS (preferred) or React

  • Working experience with PostgreSQL and MongoDB, including the ability to design sensible schemas for well-scoped features without relying on AI tools

  • Experience working with AWS services such as Lambda, S3, Aurora, DynamoDB, and IAM

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) judiciously. You treat them as helpers, not substitutes for your own understanding, and you verify what they produce

  • Clear communication skills and comfort working asynchronously on a distributed team

  • Initiative, reliability, and a commitment to quality over volume

  • A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field is preferred. Relevant certifications, bootcamp credentials, or equivalent professional experience are also welcome.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with NestJS

  • Familiarity with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools

  • Experience in nonprofit, civic tech, or education technology

We hire for character and collaboration as much as technical skill. We look for people who communicate openly, treat colleagues with respect, take initiative without waiting to be told, and care about doing things well rather than doing things fast. Given our mission, we especially value people who can engage respectfully with a wide range of perspectives.

Pay and Term

  • $50-75/hour, depending on relevant experience

  • This is not an employee role, and therefore does not include employee benefits like medical insurance, 401(k), etc. but it does give you the chance to work in a healthy, appreciative, feedback-driven workplace

  • We anticipate this role requiring 30-40 hours of work for 6 to 12 months

Ready to Apply?Great, we look forward to hearing from you! Your application materials should include a cover letter that shares three reasons why you’re right for this job (and why it’s right for you) and your resume in one, combined PDF (there will only be one field for Resume in the application, and we are looking for a combined Cover Letter/Resume in that field).

This is a contract role: please let us know if you have a history of working as a contractor and if you usually contract as an individual, as an LLC using your own social security number for taxes, or through a corporate entity with an EIN.

Let’s build something extraordinary together!

Salary: 50 - 75 USD an hour

jobs.excerpt: AECOM is seeking to hire a highly skilled Senior Mechanical Engineer for the Data Center and Mission Critical team for our east region.
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking to hire a highly skilled Senior Mechanical Engineer for the Data Center and Mission Critical team for our east region. The ideal candidate for this position should be familiar with the tech sector, mission critical and data center industry, understanding the requirements of scale, speed, and consistency in data centers.

This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office.

Although the position is primarily remote periodic travel may be required for client meetings, key project milestones, onsite collaboration sessions, or other business‑critical activities. Travel is expected to be occasional and scheduled in advance

AECOM is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high-profile, fast-paced data center projects for global clients. This is a hands-on, client-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility.

Responsibilities, required experience, and qualifications are summarized below:

Responsibilities:

  • Data Center Heat Rejection and HVAC System Design: Developing and designing Heat Rejection and HVAC systems specifically tailored for data centers, considering factors such as type of cooling requirement as air cooled or direct fluid cooled, associated cooling loads, future flexibility of the system to accommodate variable heat distribution scenarios, phased construction and operation, airflow management, humidity control, system redundancy providing concurrent maintainability, energy efficiency, and compliance with industry standards and best practices.
  • Cooling System Selection: Selecting appropriate air/water side cooling systems for data centers, including Fan wall units, computer room air handlers (CRAHs), chilled water systems, DX systems and CRAC units, in-row cooling, and containment solutions, based on the specific cooling requirements of the data center and the criticality of the equipment.
  • Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Analysis: Conducting internal CFD simulations to optimize airflow distribution, transient period analysis, identify hotspots, and ensure efficient cooling throughout the data center. Conducting external CFD on individual buildings and/or campus-wide to simulate effects of different electrical and mechanical components on each other and effects on design day selection criteria capacity of each component. For both types, prepare and/or direct preparation of models and analyse the results to recommend design modifications and optimize the Heat rejection and HVAC system performance. Coordinate the required changes and resulting effects with other trades on project.
  • Redundancy and Fault Tolerance: Designing HVAC systems with redundancy and fault-tolerant features to ensure continuous operation of the data center in the event of equipment failure or maintenance activities. This includes the design of backup cooling systems, automatic switchover mechanisms, and monitoring systems.
  • Heat Load Calculation and Capacity Planning: Performing heat load calculations for data centers to determine the cooling requirements based on the IT equipment, power density, anticipated growth, and phasing of the construction and operational steps. Conducting capacity planning to ensure the HVAC system can accommodate future expansions and upgrades. Performing HVAC loads for admin and common sections of the facility.
  • Energy Efficiency and Sustainability: Implementing energy-efficient HVAC design strategies, such as utilizing economizers, variable speed drives, energy recovery systems, and optimizing airflow management techniques, to minimize energy consumption and support sustainability initiatives.
  • Air Quality and Filtration: Ensuring the data center's air quality is maintained at optimal levels by designing appropriate filtration systems and implementing air quality monitoring mechanisms. Addressing concerns related to particulate matter, humidity control, and contaminant removal to protect sensitive IT equipment.
  • Coordination with Electrical and Mechanical Systems: Collaborating with electrical engineers and mechanical engineers to integrate the heat rejection and HVAC system seamlessly with the electrical infrastructure, UPS systems, emergency power systems, fire suppression systems, and other critical infrastructure components.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree with 8+ years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and or education.
  • Experience in data center mechanical and electrical equipment installation and operation.
  • P. E. registration is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, HVAC engineering, or a related field from an accredited university is typically required. Preference would be given to candidates with a master's degree or advanced coursework in HVAC systems or energy management.
  • Knowledge of data center TER Standard Topology as per Uptime Institute, TIA 942, ANSI/BICSI 002
  • Professional certifications related to HVAC engineering, such as Certified Energy Manager (CEM), Building Energy Modeling Professional (BEMP), or Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) accreditation, would be advantageous.
  • We are interested in every qualified candidate eligible to work in the United States. Permanent residency sponsorship is available for current H1-B visa holders in the United States.
  • Relocation assistance may be available for candidates interested in working from our Arlington, VA office.
  • THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY DECEMBER 24, 2026.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.

There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Contract type: Full time freelance | fully remote | UK working hours

About Pubity Group

Pubity Group is the largest Gen Z social publisher in the world, with an organic audience of over 170 million people spanning 20 different communities across the globe, reaching 1.6bn monthly users. Whether it’s entertaining and inspiring on Pubity, driving meme culture on Memezar or delighting animal lovers on Fluffy, Pubity Group is all about delivering joy into newsfeeds across the world.

As a leader in the digital landscape, we partner with some of the world’s most-loved brands, including: Paramount Pictures, Meta, Subway, MrBeast, Warner Bros, and Fortnite, to create impactful campaigns that resonate deeply with our audiences.

The Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Finance Analyst to join us on a freelance basis, working remotely. You’ll work closely with our UK-based finance team, supporting day-to-day finance operations, month-end close, and management reporting.

This role is a mix of hands-on transactional finance and analytical work. You’ll help keep our books accurate, process invoices and payments, support month-end journals and reconciliations, and pull together reports that help leadership make better decisions.

If you’re organised, accurate, and enjoy working with numbers in a fast-moving business, this role is a great fit.

Key Responsibilities

Month-End & Management Accounting

  • Support the month-end close, including journals, accruals, and prepayments.

  • Carry out balance sheet reconciliations and resolve queries in a timely way.

  • Maintain accurate records in Xero and keep the chart of accounts tidy.

  • Assist with year-end audit preparation when required.

Reporting & Analysis

  • Help prepare monthly management reports, including P&L, variance commentary, and KPI tracking.

  • Build and maintain Excel/Google Sheets trackers to monitor revenue, costs, and cash.

  • Flag trends, anomalies, or risks to the wider finance team.

Accounts Payable & Receivable

  • Process supplier invoices accurately and on time in Xero.

  • Prepare payment runs and reconcile supplier statements.

  • Raise sales invoices and support credit control / chasing overdue payments.

  • Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and expense claims.

General Finance Support

  • Respond to internal finance queries from across the business.

  • Help document and improve finance processes and SOPs.

  • Support ad hoc projects as the finance function grows.

Process Improvements

  • Work to consistently improve processes over time.

  • Use AI tools to speed up and improve your output over time.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 2-4 years’ experience in a finance role covering management accounts, AP/AR, and reporting.

  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills – confident with formulas, pivot tables, and lookups.

  • Fluent written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate clearly with a UK-based team.

  • Accurate, organised, and able to manage your own workload to deadlines.

  • Comfortable working UK hours and fully remotely.

Desired Skills & Attributes

  • Hands-on experience with Xero

  • Experience working with a UK-based business or international finance team.

  • Exposure to media, digital, or creative industries.

  • Familiarity with reporting tools (e.g. Looker Studio, Power BI) or AI tools for finance workflows.

  • AI forward individual, experienced with tools like Claude

Why Pubity Group?

We are the world’s biggest Gen Z publisher, built on culture, community, and creativity. You’ll join a friendly, fast-moving finance team where your work has visible impact, and you’ll get real ownership of your areas from day one.

Application instructions:

Please submit your CV alongside a video answering the questions below. You can attach it in any format. We're assessing your transferable skills and communication style, so please don't worry about editing or production quality.

  • Walk me through a specific task in your last finance role where you used AI or automation to save time or improve accuracy. What did you do, how did you check the output was right, and what would you do differently now?

  • Where do you see yourself in two to three years and how could this role at Pubity help you get there?

  • It's month-end, you're reconciling the bank and a variance doesn't add up. The deadline is tomorrow and no one is around. How would you prioritise, approach it and decide when to escalate?

Role Overview

For 60 years, Good Sam has helped people travel the road with confidence. We are one of the most recognized names in RV and outdoor travel, offering roadside assistance, extended service plans, insurance, and a membership that connects millions of travelers to savings, services, and each other. Good Sam has been there for a lot of first nights at a campground, a lot of calls from the shoulder of a highway, and a lot of families who grew up on the road.

We are now investing in the brand like never before, with a refreshed brand strategy and new full-funnel marketing programs designed to reach a new generation of travelers. At the same time, the way people choose a brand is changing. More and more, travelers make decisions based on what others say: reviews, creator videos, online communities, published rankings, and the answers AI assistants give when they ask for a recommendation. Growing a brand today means earning trust in all of those places.

The Director of Brand & Community will help grow and protect the Good Sam brand. Reporting to the VP of Brand, this hands-on leader will bring creators, social media, community, and earned media together to build awareness and drive growth, and will lead the work that builds trust in Good Sam across review sites, online forums, and the press. The goal is simple: more people who know Good Sam, trust Good Sam, and feel like part of the Good Sam community. This role works closely with teams across marketing, creative, customer experience, and legal.

  • Partner with performance marketing and paid media teams on campaign planning, including peak travel seasons and new product launches, so brand and performance goals move together.
  • Provide authentic content for paid campaigns, including creator content, member stories, awards, and rankings, that helps people choose Good Sam with confidence.
  • Extend major campaigns, events, and cultural moments across creator, social, community, and earned channels so every big idea reaches further than paid media alone.

  • Own Good Sam’s creator and influencer program, building a vetted bench of micro and macro partners aligned to brand values, with clear vetting criteria and brand-safety standards.

jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Data Protection Security Investigations Analyst 2 works with EIP stakeholders and Humana’s teams to identify high risk insider activity and ensure appropriate controls are in place to mitigate potential data loss or malicious activity. Understands department, segment, and organizational strategy and operating objectives, including their linkages to related areas. Makes decisions regarding own work methods, occasionally in ambiguous situations, and requires minimal direction and receives guidance where needed. Follows established guidelines/procedures.

The Data Protection Investigations Analyst (P2) supports enterprise Data Protection Operations through level two alert triage, investigation support, evidence review, and stakeholder coordination. The analyst evaluates alerts, logs, user activity, system indicators, and related evidence to identify potential data exposure, unauthorized movement, policy violations, and insider risk.

The analyst partners with Enterprise Information Protection, Humana Resources, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and business teams on investigations, security reviews, control questions, and evidence requests. The role strengthens Data Protection Operations through accurate case documentation, disciplined queue management, evidence organization, process improvement, and consistent execution.

A key focus is providing enterprise-aligned support to subsidiaries and affiliated businesses while maintaining consistent investigation, evidence-handling, documentation, escalation, privacy, and compliance standards.


Use your skills to make an impact

DLP Alert Analysis and Data Protection Operations

  • Analyze DLP alerts and controls across email, endpoint, web, cloud/CASB, collaboration, and data classification platforms to validate policy behavior, assess business context, and recommend actions.
  • Explain DLP, data classification, and information protection controls to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Serve as a centralized point of intake for Data Protection inquiries, control questions, investigation requests, exceptions, and incident or problem tickets; triage and coordinate each request through resolution or appropriate escalation.

Insider Risk and Data Exposure Support

  • Investigate indicators such as unusual data access, bulk downloads, unauthorized sharing, unapproved storage, or attempts to bypass controls.
  • Assess events using user activity, data sensitivity, destination, control action, business context, and historical patterns.
  • Coordinate additional review or escalation within Threat Management & Response, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Human Resources, and business stakeholders.
  • Maintain objective, evidence-based documentation that supports consistent, defensible decisions.

Incident Coordination, Escalation, and Stakeholder Support

  • Coordinate response and escalation when an investigation identifies elevated risk, a potential incident, or the need for specialized review.
  • Partner with Threat Management & Response, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Human Resources, and business teams to resolve investigations and reduce data-loss risk.
  • Respond to inquiries about DLP alerts, data classification, control behavior, approved exception handling, security reviews, and operational processes.
  • Communicate findings, limitations, and recommended next steps clearly to technical and business audiences.

Documentation, Metrics, and Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain accurate case notes, investigation summaries, standard operating procedures, runbooks, knowledge articles, and triage materials.
  • Compile operational data on alert and investigation volume, service-level performance, queue aging, case quality, exception reviews, subsidiary support, compliance evidence, and control effectiveness.
  • Identify recurring control issues and opportunities to improve triage consistency, service-level performance, evidence handling, automation, and repeatable workflows across enterprise operations.
  • Meet established service levels, maintain complete and accurate case records, reduce avoidable queue aging, and escalate blockers or emerging risk promptly.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Two or more years of relevant technical experience, including at least one year in Data Security, Cyber Data Protection, DLP, security operations, insider risk, incident response support, or a related field.
  • Experience triaging security alerts, reviewing logs, collecting evidence, documenting findings, and supporting investigations or incident response.
  • Working knowledge of DLP, data classification, information protection, security monitoring, data handling, and common exposure scenarios.
  • Ability to analyze routine to moderately complex issues, follow established procedures, and make sound, evidence-based recommendations.
  • Experience supporting centralized intake, ticket handling, case management, or operational queues with consistent prioritization and follow-up.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills for explaining Data Security controls to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Commitment to accurate documentation and continuous improvement of scalable, efficient workflows.
  • Ability to responsibly use approved AI-enabled tools to improve investigation efficiency, documentation quality, process consistency, and decision support while protecting sensitive information and complying with security, privacy, legal, and regulatory requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with one or more enterprise Data Protection technology categories, such as DLP, data classification, CASB, SIEM, endpoint security, email security, or data-security posture management.
  • Hands-on experience with representative platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Zscaler, CrowdStrike, Proofpoint, Symantec, Splunk, Google Security Operations, Microsoft Sentinel, Cyera, Netskope, or comparable tools.
  • Experience in regulated environments such as healthcare, insurance, financial services, or other settings with heightened privacy, compliance, and data protection requirements.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA/HITECH, PCI DSS, GLBA, NIST, SOC 2, HITRUST, or related security, privacy, and compliance frameworks.
  • Security-related certification such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, GSEC, or a relevant vendor certification, or progress toward certification; advanced certifications such as CISSP or CISM are beneficial.
  • Experience supporting investigations involving insider risk, data exfiltration, cloud application use, web activity, unauthorized sharing, or inappropriate data movement.
  • Experience reviewing security documentation, cloud service requests, data risk information, vendor or SaaS intake, or security control exceptions.

Operating Expectations

  • Handles sensitive and regulated information in accordance with established security, privacy, legal, records-management, and evidence-handling requirements.
  • Participates in scheduled or after-hours support, escalation, travel, and workplace arrangements when required by the position and defined in the final posting.

Work Style and Decision Scope

  • Completes assigned work with appropriate guidance, using established procedures, playbooks, knowledge articles, and escalation criteria.
  • Exercises limited to moderate latitude in triage, analysis, documentation, and follow-up.
  • Makes operational recommendations based on evidence, documented control behavior, data sensitivity, risk indicators, and business context.
  • Escalates events that exceed thresholds, present elevated risk, require specialized technical review, or need cross-functional decisions.
  • Maintains a support-oriented approach while balancing control effectiveness, user impact, compliance, privacy, and data protection outcomes.
  • Works independently on routine tasks and seeks guidance on ambiguous, sensitive, high-risk, or precedent-setting matters.

Potential Locations

  • Louisville, KY
  • Washington, D.C. / Arlington Metro
  • Dallas / Frisco, TX
  • Fort Lauderdale / Tampa, FL
  • Nashville, TN
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Join a Team That’s Passionate About Making Lives Better!

At Bill Gosling Outsourcing, we believe that success starts with an amazing team. We are a global leader in outsourcing solutions, we focus on making lives better, one connection at a time. We provide tailored solutions to businesses around the globe, specializing in customer care, sales, and financial services. We’re looking for enthusiastic, driven individuals to join our dynamic work environment where fun meets results!

The Director, AI Data Operations is responsible for building, launching, and scaling our business' AI Data Operations practice, establishing the solutions, capabilities, partnerships, delivery models, and go-to-market strategy required to support organizations developing and deploying artificial intelligence at scale.

This role combines AI domain expertise, commercial leadership, solution design, practice development, and global operations experience. The Director will identify emerging opportunities across the AI development and deployment lifecycle and translate complex or evolving client requirements into scalable managed-service solutions.

The role will establish the company's capabilities across AI/ML data operations, training and evaluation datasets, data labeling and multimodal annotation, model evaluation, human-in-the-loop systems, reinforcement learning and human preference data, agentic AI operations, AI quality and safety, computer vision, autonomous systems, data governance, and production AI monitoring.

The Director will also serve as a senior external representative of the company within the AI ecosystem, developing relationships with AI-native companies, technology platforms, hyperscalers, autonomous-systems organizations, specialist AI-data providers, and enterprise AI teams.

Ultimately, the role is accountable for transforming AI Data Operations from an emerging market opportunity into a scalable and commercially viable company practice and revenue stream.

What You'll Do:

Key Details:

Location: Remote role within the US

Salary: base salary of up to $200k + annual bonus

Working Hours: within EST

Ideally 5+ years of consulting and sales experience


Key Responsibilities:

1. Build the AI Data Operations Practice

  • Define BGO’s AI Data Operations strategy, service portfolio, positioning, and go-to-market proposition.
  • Identify high-value opportunities across the AI development, training, evaluation, deployment, and production lifecycle.
  • Develop repeatable solutions, operating models, delivery methodologies, commercial constructs, governance frameworks, and implementation playbooks.
  • Establish scalable capabilities across emerging AI operations categories.
  • Evaluate capability gaps and recommend whether BGO should build, partner, or acquire capabilities required to support the practice.
  • Develop the organizational, technology, talent, quality, governance, and delivery requirements necessary to scale AI Data Operations globally.
  • Establish appropriate performance indicators and operational standards for AI Data Operations engagements.

2. Create and Win Client Opportunities

  • Develop relationships with AI-native companies, technology platforms, hyperscalers, autonomous-systems companies, and enterprises deploying AI at scale.
  • Engage senior stakeholders across AI, Data, Product, Technology, Operations, Procurement, and related functions.
  • Identify and diagnose operational bottlenecks across AI development and production environments.
  • Translate ambiguous or emerging client challenges into clearly defined and commercially viable operational solutions.
  • Lead client discovery sessions, solution workshops, presentations, proposals, and commercial negotiations.
  • Partner with Sales, Solutions, Operations, Technology, and other BGO functions to develop differentiated client propositions.
  • Personally originate and support the closure of BGO’s initial generation of AI Data Operations engagements.
  • Develop sustainable opportunity pipelines and new revenue streams for the practice.

3. Design AI-Native Operations Solutions

  • Data collection, preparation, enrichment, curation, and validation.
  • Training and evaluation dataset operations.
  • Data labeling and annotation.
  • Multimodal annotation across text, image, audio, and video.
  • Model evaluation, benchmarking, and validation.
  • Human preference data and reinforcement-learning workflows.
  • Human-in-the-loop operations.
  • AI exception management and escalation.
  • AI quality assurance and output validation.
  • Agent evaluation, monitoring, and escalation.
  • Trust & Safety and policy-enforcement operations.
  • Mapping, geospatial, and location-data operations.
  • Computer vision data operations.
  • Autonomous systems and robotics data operations.
  • Red teaming and adversarial-testing operations.
  • AI workflow monitoring.
  • Continuous model-improvement operations.

4. Establish AI Quality, Governance and Operational Controls

  • Establish quality frameworks appropriate for AI training, evaluation, and production operations.
  • Incorporate data governance, privacy, security, and responsible-data-handling requirements into solution design.
  • Develop quality-control and quality-assurance mechanisms for human-generated and human-validated AI data.
  • Establish appropriate human-in-the-loop escalation and exception-management frameworks.
  • Partner with BGO Technology, Information Security, Privacy, Legal, Risk, and Operations teams to ensure solutions meet applicable internal and client requirements.
  • Establish production-monitoring frameworks that support ongoing quality measurement and continuous improvement.

5. Build Market Presence and Thought Leadership

  • Represent BGO in strategic client and industry conversations regarding AI Data Operations.
  • Develop strong market perspectives on how human operations will evolve as AI systems become increasingly autonomous.
  • Develop client-facing thought leadership, solution narratives, use cases, presentations, and market perspectives.
  • Monitor developments across AI models, agentic AI, autonomous systems, AI safety, data services, and emerging AI operations categories.
  • Translate emerging technology trends into practical service opportunities for BGO.
  • Position BGO as a credible operating partner within the AI and data ecosystem.

6. Build Strategic Partnerships and Ecosystem Relationships

  • Develop partnerships across the AI technology and data ecosystem.
  • Build relationships with AI-native companies, hyperscalers, AI platforms, data technology providers, autonomous-systems organizations, and specialist service providers.
  • Evaluate partnership opportunities that accelerate BGO’s market entry or extend its capabilities.
  • Develop partner-enabled solutions where appropriate.

7. Enable Global Delivery and Scale

  • Work with global delivery teams to translate solution concepts into scalable operating models.
  • Define workforce, workflow, quality, governance, technology, and performance requirements for new AI services.
  • Support transition from pilot or proof-of-concept engagements into sustainable managed-service operations.
  • Establish repeatable delivery standards and playbooks across locations.

jobs.excerpt: Maybe you call yourself a Senior Data Engineer or an Azure wrangler, a Databricks whisperer, a senior "works-on-my-cluster" engineer… or maybe you just call yourself Sam.
jobs.description:
Maybe you call yourself a Senior Data Engineer or an Azure wrangler, a Databricks whisperer, a senior "works-on-my-cluster" engineer… or maybe you just call yourself Sam. Whatever you call yourself, you'll join our Delivery team and build the data platforms our clients actually run on, the pipelines and models behind the moment a client leans forward and says "wait, show me that again."

What you get

  • A salary between €3,900–€5,000/gross monthly, based on the role, your experience, and your local market.

  • €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it.

  • 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months.

  • Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings.

  • €500 home-office budget and a great laptop.

  • A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", so now and then.

  • Fully remote, from anywhere in Europe, ideally within a couple of hours of CET, so the team overlaps.

Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR.

About us

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. We work according to Holacracy: little hierarchy, lots of ownership. Serious work. Serious fun.

What the job looks like

  • Build and own the Azure data platforms our client accounts run on, SQL Server, Databricks, pipelines end to end.

  • Design the data models that keep it all maintainable, and Kimball dimensional modelling, where it earns its place.

  • Challenge a requirement when it doesn't add up, and bring a better option. We'd rather you push back than build the wrong thing well.

  • Take a genuinely messy, complex data problem and turn it into something the client, and the team, can actually follow.

  • Reason about what the work changes for the client, not just the ticket in front of you.

Requirements

What you bring

  • Attitude: honest and constructive. You have the real conversations, and you'll challenge something that doesn't make sense, kindly, with an alternative in hand.

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience as a Senior Data Engineer, designing, building, and maintaining scalable, reliable data platforms and pipelines in production environments.

  • Azure data engineering: hands-on across the Azure stack, including SQL Server and Databricks. You build platforms, not just wire them together.

  • Data modelling: Kimball dimensional modelling is second nature.

  • Impact over output: you think about what the work changes, not just the code you ship.

  • Communication: you can take something genuinely complex and make it land, for a teammate or a non-technical client, without needing someone else to translate for you.

  • Track record: at least one role you stayed in long enough to deliver something real, and recent proof you keep learning, a new tool, a cert, an idea you ran with.

  • Nice to have: a real IT education and solid software-engineering foundations, functional and object-oriented programming. Data Vault, logistics or industrial data experience, and Dutch are pluses too.

We're 60+ data heroes across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.

ROLE PURPOSE


As a member of the Client Solutions leadership team, this role sets and executes Guardian’s enterprise financial planning strategy across channels and client segments. The leader builds a protection-first, holistic planning model that integrates insurance, retirement, investments, and wealth management; converts advanced-market expertise into actionable solutions; and scales consistent delivery for advisors and clients.

Key Accountabilities

Enterprise Planning Strategy & Operating Model

  • Partner with the Head of Client Solutions to align strategy and then design, evolve, and execute a comprehensive protection first, holistic financial planning strategy and framework.
  • Define the planning function’s governance, workflows, technology platforms, service standards, decision rights, and process improvements to enable efficient, consistent, and scalable execution.
  • Clarify how each planning discipline is reflected within the enterprise framework and how solutions align to distinct client and advisor segments.
  • Monitor competitive dynamics, industry trends, regulatory developments, and evolving client needs to keep the offering differentiated and relevant.

Planning Solutions, Experience & Digital Scale

  • Design scalable planning models and deliverables for clients and advisors, with tailored approaches for complex HNW and UHNW needs.
  • Lead the evolution and adoption of digital planning capabilities that improve planning quality, advisor productivity, client engagement, and scale.
  • Translate complex financial concepts and technical thought leadership into practical tools, frameworks, case designs, and client-friendly recommendations.
  • Evaluate and integrate third-party capabilities where they strengthen the planning proposition and client experience.

Advanced Markets & Complex Planning

  • Identify opportunities to strengthen Guardian’s HNW and UHNW value proposition through innovative, competitive planning solutions.

  • Establish planning best practices, advisor enablement programs, training, and coaching strategies in partnership with distribution, regional and field leaders, product teams, and CSWM leadership.

  • Partner with marketing and communications to ensure the protection-first, holistic planning approach is reflected clearly and consistently in internal and external content.

Enterprise Alignment, Performance & Risk

  • Influence product development, distribution strategy, and executive decision-making through data-driven insights, client outcomes, market intelligence, and planning trends.

  • Establish accountability and performance-management disciplines that improve financial planning quality, consistency, adoption, client outcomes, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Partner with legal and compliance to ensure advanced planning strategies, solutions, and supporting practices align with regulatory requirements, risk standards, and firm policies.

Team & Leadership

  • Build and lead a high-performing team of financial planning and advanced-market professionals
  • Set clear priorities, operating rhythms, and development expectations; allocate expertise against the highest-value enterprise, advisor, and client needs.
  • Model sound judgment, integrity, collaboration, and executive-level communication while influencing senior stakeholders across the enterprise.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in financial services, wealth management, financial planning, or a related field, including significant leadership responsibility.

  • Deep understanding of how life insurance, annuities, retirement, investments, and protection solutions work together in a holistic financial plan.
  • Knowledge of advanced planning concepts and the ability to translate complex technical information into actionable, client- and advisor-friendly solutions.
  • Experience using technology, digital capabilities, data, and performance measures to improve planning quality, adoption, productivity, and business outcomes.
  • Proven ability to lead teams and influence senior stakeholders across distribution, product, operations, technology, marketing, legal, and compliance.
  • Strong strategic thinking, business acumen, communication, judgment, integrity, and collaboration skills.
  • Commitment to Guardian’s purpose of helping clients protect what matters and achieve long-term financial security.

The Role

MLR review is one of the Life Science industry's biggest bottlenecks - and we're rebuilding it with AI.

Falcon MLR is Veeva's AI application for medical, legal, and regulatory (MLR) review. Our AI agents review promotional material the way expert reviewers do: against the actual rules of each market and the science behind the claims. We're looking for an MLR expert to take ownership of review quality across Europe.

You have sat in the review meetings. You know the codes, the process, and their pain points. Now, help build the reviewer and shape the future of MLR for the entire Life Science industry. You'll work directly with Falcon MLR's founding team, and your judgment will ship into a product used globally by the top Pharmaceutical companies.

We work like a start-up inside Veeva. The team is small, you own your area end to end, and your decisions reach the product fast. It suits people who like to build and take ownership.

Jobs that combine deep MLR expertise with frontier AI barely exist. This is one.

  • Maximize reviewer agreement with Falcon's findings across our EU markets
  • Lead our regulatory monitoring system with engineering and product, and coordinate with other regions
  • Operationalize the reviewer-feedback loop, turning customer inputs into product improvements
  • Investigate, diagnose and resolve “why did Falcon flag this?” - read the agent's traces, find the root cause, fix it. Build the process for handling these questions with users
  • Automate recurring tasks with AI workflows
  • Ownership of quality benchmarks e.g. review quality, in cross functional collaboration with engineering and product

About Prisma International, Inc. (Prisma) - Prisma is a dynamic and growing language services provider committed to delivering exceptional Interpretation solutions to clients worldwide. We pride ourselves on our dedication to linguistic excellence and client satisfaction.

Prisma is hiring experienced LEGAL INTERPRETERS to join our team as independent contractors. In this role you will provide Over-the-Phone (on-demand & pre-scheduled) and Video Remote (pre-scheduled) interpreting services to various Prisma clients including the South Dakota DHS/LTSS offices. This is a 100% remote position.

The following languages are in demand:

SPANISH plus Amharic, Chinese (Mandarin), Dakota, German, Karen, Lakota, Nakota, Nepali, Serbian, Somali, Tagalog and Vietnamese

If your language is not listed above, you are encouraged to apply if you meet ALL of the minimum requirements listed below.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS - You must meet ALL of the following:

  • Court certified (state or federal) - OR - court qualified/registered credentials - you will be asked to provide your certificates, proof of training, etc.
  • Agree to a criminal history background check.
  • Agree to complete training/courses in data security protocols and protection of personal information.
  • At least two (2) years of experience providing OPI and VRI interpretation in a professional setting.
  • Two (2) references who can confirm your profession as a legal interpreter.
  • Minimum age: 18+ years or older.
  • Minimum education: High School Diploma.
  • Location: Must live in the United States.
  • Fluent in English and the target language.

Candidates must be able to provide:

  • OPI and VRI service between a state government representative and non-English speakers.
  • Polite forms of expression, enunciation, and a high-level of customer service.
  • Deliver correct concepts and meanings between speaker and the Limited English Proficient (LEP) speaker.
  • Correct grammar, clarity and tones between English and your native language.
  • Experience with following the speakers’ direction, professionally interject when clarification is needed, and manage the flow of a conversation.
  • Refrain from side conversations with the LEP speaker or entering into any disagreement with the customer or LEP speaker.
  • Strict adherence to data security protocols and protection of personal information.
  • Compliance with applicable ethics and standards.

DESIRED SKILLS:

Professional appearance, polite demeanor and respect for punctuality.

SECURITY REQUIREMENTS:
Applicants must undergo a criminal history background check.

IMPORTANT APPLICANT SECURITY NOTICE:

Prisma will never ask for payment information or fee transfers during recruitment or employment preparation. Legitimate outreach for information will only originate from official @ email addresses.
