jobs.description:
t peopleworth, we support work where people and performance thrive. As part of our Employer Group, we work with a variety of forward-thinking partners and are excited to share this opportunity that sits within our growing group.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced AI Strategy and Leadership Lead Facilitator to support senior professionals participating in an applied AI strategy and leadership learning experience.

This is a remote, fixed-term, part-time opportunity suited to someone with significant senior leadership experience and direct accountability for AI strategy, investment, transformation, or implementation decisions. The role combines live online facilitation, executive-level discussion, learner mentoring, assignment feedback, and online community engagement.

The expected commitment is approximately 4 to 6 hours per week on average, although additional hours may be required during assignment grading periods.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated senior leadership experience with direct accountability for AI strategy, investment, implementation, digital transformation, data strategy, or related organisational decision-making.
  • Experience operating at executive, general management, functional leadership, senior advisory, or equivalent level.
  • Working knowledge of the Australian regulatory and governance environment relevant to artificial intelligence.
  • Understanding of developments including Australian privacy reform, the Voluntary AI Safety Standard, and expectations associated with relevant Australian regulatory bodies.
  • Practical fluency with current generative AI tools and the ability to assess and direct their use without dependence on a single technology vendor.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage confidently with senior, experienced, and time-constrained participants while constructively challenging ideas and assumptions.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence, with the ability to support a diverse group of senior professionals.
  • Previous experience in facilitation, executive education, teaching, coaching, mentoring, or professional development.
  • Excellent organisational, time-management, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • A flexible and practical problem-solving approach, with the ability to adapt facilitation to participant needs and evolving discussions.

    Key Responsibilities
  • Facilitate engaging live online group sessions that connect AI strategy and leadership concepts with practical executive and organisational experience.
  • Lead regular online drop-in sessions focused on real-world AI applications, strategic decision-making, governance considerations, and learner assignments.
  • Mark approximately 20 to 50 assignments per course and provide clear, constructive, and actionable feedback that supports participant development.
  • Facilitate meaningful discussions within an online learning community by sharing resources, practical examples, insights, and responses to participant questions.
  • Provide ad hoc one-to-one mentoring sessions to participants requiring additional support with course concepts, assignments, or strategic application.
  • Participate in selected industry panel discussions and contribute relevant senior-level perspectives on AI strategy, leadership, governance, investment, and implementation.
  • Set clear expectations regarding workload, assignment timelines, learning activities, and available resources.
  • Monitor participant engagement and identify areas where additional support or intervention may be appropriate.
  • Collaborate with relevant delivery and participant-support colleagues to communicate progress, challenges, and emerging learner needs.
  • Support a senior participant cohort by facilitating constructive discussion, challenging assumptions appropriately, and encouraging evidence-based strategic thinking.

Benefits

Collaborative, people-centred performance culture.

Opportunities to grow in a fast-paced environment.

Opportunity to apply senior AI leadership experience in a learning, facilitation, and executive development setting.

Our Recruitment Process

The peopleworth Employer Group follows a fair, transparent, and multi-stage recruitment process designed to ensure mutual fit.

  1. Application Submission: Complete the online form and answer brief application questions.
  2. Initial Screening: Your application is reviewed for role alignment; successful candidates move to the longlist.
  3. Video Interview Stage: You’ll be invited to record short responses to 3–4 role-specific questions.
  4. Live Interviews: Shortlisted candidates join first-round interviews (and, where applicable, second or third rounds depending on the role).
  5. Final Shortlist & Verification: Reference and background checks are completed.
  6. Offer & Contracting: Successful candidates receive formal offers and contract documents.
  7. Pre-boarding & Onboarding: Once accepted, you’ll complete a pre-boarding process before officially joining your employing organisation within the Employer Group.

Throughout every stage, we value clear communication, respectful engagement, and timely feedback.

jobs.description:
About This Role

As a Principal IT Analyst, you will play a critical role in designing, building, implementing, and maintaining Veeva Vault RIM. Biogen is undergoing a business transformation with technology as a core enabler. Veeva Vault RIM is a critical component of this transformation, and you will be leveraging your expertise to ensure high-quality service delivery, optimal system performance, and seamless user experiences. Acting as the IT Techno-Functional Analyst, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, technical architects, system configurators and project managers, to deliver upgrades, enhancements, new modules, and other initiatives aligned with strategic business roadmaps. Your work will directly support Biogen’s Employee Experience and GxP compliance, ensuring that our RIM system meets regulatory requirements and user needs. This role combines technical leadership, business process understanding, and hands-on implementation, making it integral to our commitment to excellence in RIM.


What You’ll Do

  • Plan and implement complex enhancements and incremental updates to Veeva Vault RIM application including adding additional modules to the existing vault implementation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional business and IT teams to avoid misunderstanding between requirements and developers work, reducing errors / findings by business testing and multiple rounds rework
  • Work with the IT System Owner (ITSO) to implement a strategic application roadmap that supports business and functional objectives.
  • Translating Business Requirements into Veeva RIM functional & solution specifications, providing impact analysis on current configurations and dependencies to ensure solution fitness
  • Develop and facilitate strategies for system, data and application integration, ensuring that interfaces supporting business requirements are properly identified, designed, and implemented.
  • Provide oversight and mentor development teams. Work with and manage team of internal and external 3rd party technical resources performing analysis, design, configuration, development, testing, and deployment activities.
  • Conduct in-depth research on emerging technologies, including AI, to support systems development initiatives. Provide expert guidance to IT and Business management regarding technology trends and best practices that optimize solutions.
  • Test new applications, major/minor releases, and recommend feature enhancements for system optimization.
  • Develop, roll out, and support business and application services to meet evolving user needs.
  • Support M&A and Divestiture activities by extracting or importing data into target systems as needed, including coordinating with the support team as required

Who You Are

You are a resourceful and solution-oriented IT professional who thrives on delivering exceptional customer experience. You excel at troubleshooting complex issues, conducting root cause analyses, and driving continuous improvement. Your ability to adapt to varying technical expertise levels enables you to effectively communicate with both business subject matter experts and IT architects. You are passionate about leveraging technology to enhance regulatory business processes and ensure compliance in a regulated environment.


Required Skills

  • 5+ years of IT experience, including 2 years in Veeva RIM administration and service delivery.
  • An undergraduate degree in Computer Science or equivalent education and experience.
  • Expert technical knowledge of RIM platforms, preferably with relevant certifications.
  • Proven expertise in data analytics, reporting, and dashboarding tools such as advanced Microsoft Excel, PowerBI, Tableau, or other business intelligence platforms.
  • Knowledge of industry best practices in RIM.
  • Experience in user and application support.
  • Familiarity with incident and change management processes.
  • Understanding of SAFe Agile framework.
  • Strong communication skills to work both with business leaders and IT teams

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in SLA management.
  • Understanding of middleware, SFTP, Single Sign-On, and enterprise architecture concepts.

Job Level: Management

Additional Information

The base compensation range for this role is: $121,000.00-$161,500.00

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.


Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.


In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families physical, financial, emotional, and social well-being; including, but not limited to:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life insurances
  • Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance
  • A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)
  • Up to 12 company paid holidays + 3 paid days off for Personal Significance
  • 80 hours of sick time per calendar year
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
  • 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions
  • Employee stock purchase plan
  • Tuition reimbursement of up to $10,000 per calendar year
  • Employee Resource Groups participation

Why Biogen?

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.


At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. This role aligns to industry level titles such as Product Manager, K12 Assessment, or Product Manager, Classroom Assessment

Product Specialists are recognized as subject matter experts in assigned PALS products and are responsible for translating product capabilities into clear, scalable training, support, and go-to-market assets. They also play an active role in product discovery and delivery by gathering requirements, facilitating design discussions, documenting workflows, and helping shape solutions that address educator and district needs.

Working closely with senior-level Product Managers, Product Specialists help ensure products are well understood, effectively adopted, and continuously improved. The Product Specialist helps bring roadmap strategies to life through customer insight, requirements definition, product documentation, and enablement. This role is for someone who:

  • Enjoys translating complex ideas into clear, actionable content and requirements
  • Thrives at collaborating across product, design, engineering, marketing, and training teams
  • Can facilitate discussions, gather input, and drive clarity from ambiguity
  • Is passionate about helping educators and students succeed
  • Wants to grow product management, voice of customer research, and enablement skills simultaneously
  • Takes initiative and can independently drive projects to completion

Product Thinking & Problem Solving

  • Ability to translate customer needs into product requirements and recommendations
  • Comfortable facilitating conversations that uncover root causes and clarify requirements
  • Ability to balance customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints

Product Communication & Documentation

  • Ability to create clear requirements, workflows, and training materials
  • Strong presentation and facilitation skills
  • Skilled at tailoring content for different audiences

Product Expertise & Customer Understanding

  • Develop deep expertise in assigned products, workflows, and use cases
  • Understand educator, administrator, and district perspectives
  • Serve as a trusted resource across functional teams

Execution & Collaboration

  • Strong project management and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Experience working across cross-functional teams
  • Attention to detail and commitment to quality

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree

  • 3–5+ years of experience in educational technology, assessment, professional learning, product support, curriculum development, or related fields

  • Experience creating training, professional learning, support materials, or customer-facing content

  • Experience gathering requirements, documenting workflows, or supporting product development efforts

Preferred

  • Experience participating in Agile product development environments
  • Familiarity with product management tools and practices

  • A highly collaborative, mission-driven team

jobs.excerpt: Senior Manager, Compliance & Employee RelationsAbout the RoleEvery day, teacher absences cost students learning time, a loss felt hardest in under-resourced schools.
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Compliance & Employee Relations

About the Role

Every day, teacher absences cost students learning time, a loss felt hardest in under-resourced schools. Kokua closes that gap by connecting schools with passionate guest educators who step in and make an immediate difference in the classroom, delivering substitute teaching staffing services across a growing, multi-state footprint that we're continuing to expand.

At Kokua, compliance is how we keep classrooms safe and covered. Every guest educator we place has to be screened, cleared, and credentialed for the state, district, and school they're working in. If that work is wrong, students may be put at risk. If it's slow or overly complex, classrooms go uncovered. Either way, school partners lose trust in us. Getting it right is central to the service we provide.

The Senior Manager, Compliance & Employee Relations owns Kokua's workforce compliance framework: the standards, controls, and employee relations expertise that keep Kokua's people practices sound as the company scales into new states. Rather than owning every process that touches a compliance requirement, you'll translate legal and regulatory complexity into simple, scalable processes that Talent, Operations, and other frontline teams can execute themselves, with you providing the oversight, monitoring, training, and escalation path that keeps it all working.

You'll work closely with Talent, Operations, Payroll, and HRBP to make sure compliance gets executed where the work actually happens, not just designed centrally and handed down.

Essential Duties

Educator clearance and student safety

  • Maintain a requirements matrix by state, market, and school partner covering screening, credentialing, training, and other placement requirements.
  • Define background screening, fingerprinting, credentialing, and mandatory reporting training requirements for guest educators.
  • Establish controls that prevent assignments before required clearance is complete, and monitor those controls for gaps.
  • Coordinate educator misconduct matters and required reporting with Operations, the VP of People, and counsel.

Employee relations case management and investigations

  • Independently manage routine and moderately complex ER cases, including investigation, documentation, recommendations, and resolution. Escalate high-risk or legally complex matters to the VP of People and/or external counsel as appropriate.
  • Partner with managers and HRBPs to determine appropriate responses, corrective action, and follow-up.

Compliance program ownership

  • Own the standards, controls, and framework for Kokua's workforce compliance program across the full employee lifecycle, from hiring and onboarding through employment changes, leaves and accommodations, and separation. Talent, Operations, Payroll, and other functions execute the day-to-day steps within that framework.
  • Develop and maintain scalable processes, controls, documentation, and training that make compliance requirements simple enough for regional and frontline teams to execute consistently, and own audit readiness across applicable federal, state, and local requirements.
  • Monitor changes in employment requirements, assess their impact on Kokua's policies and processes, and translate those changes into updated guidance for the teams responsible for applying them.

Partnership with HRBP

  • Serve as the specialist partner to the HRBP function, owning compliance standards, formal investigations, and guidance on employee relations risk, while HRBPs lead business partnership, organizational effectiveness, manager coaching, and routine performance support.
  • Work with HRBPs to keep that line clear in practice, with defined handoffs when a performance or manager issue picks up compliance or ER risk and needs to move into a formal process.
  • Support HRBPs and leaders in situations that involve both organizational or performance considerations and compliance or ER risk, bringing the specialist lens without taking over the business relationship.

New market launch support

  • Own the compliance readiness checklist for each proposed market, including requirements, accountable owners, dependencies, deadlines, and unresolved risks.
  • Provide a documented readiness recommendation before launch and promptly escalate issues that could affect the launch date.
  • Research applicable employment and workforce requirements and identify changes needed to policies, processes, systems, and training.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external counsel to ensure compliance requirements are understood and operationalized before launch.
  • Build scalable approaches that allow Kokua to enter new jurisdictions without unnecessarily creating complexity for frontline teams.

Risk escalation and advisory

  • Help leaders assess risk, determine appropriate next steps, and understand when an issue requires escalation.
  • Provide practical guidance on matters that may arise throughout the employee lifecycle, including accommodations, leave, employee conduct, workplace safety, wage and hour, immigration, and other employment-related compliance issues.

Reporting

  • ER resolution: track case volume, resolution timelines, and complexity trends to give leadership a clear, current picture of ER health and workload.
  • Compliance readiness: report on audit results, credentialing and background-check accuracy, and the status of any open remediation items across Kokua's markets.
  • New market readiness: track whether compliant policies and processes are in place ahead of confirmed market launches, and flag readiness gaps early.
  • Business enablement: track how the range of issues Talent and Operations teams are equipped to handle independently continues to grow, and the resulting reduction in escalations to the central team.

Qualifications

Required

  • 6+ years of progressive HR, employee relations, or compliance experience, including direct investigation experience
  • Demonstrated success implementing multi-state compliance programs in a high-volume, distributed workforce, with measurable improvements in accuracy, turnaround time, or operational simplicity.
  • Strong working knowledge of employment practices and requirements across multiple U.S. jurisdictions
  • Experience with I-9/E-Verify, background and credential compliance, wage and hour, leave, accommodations, or other workforce compliance programs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex or sensitive issues clearly to non-HR audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities, and build structure in a growing organization.

Preferred

  • Experience in high-complexity, employee-protective states such as New York, Illinois, or California
  • PHR/SPHR or SHRM-CP/SCP
  • Experience in staffing, contingent workforce, or education-sector HR
  • Experience supporting or leading HR/compliance work associated with entering a new state or market
  • Experience designing compliance tools or training for non-HR audiences

Compensation

This role may be performed remotely from anywhere in the United States, with a preference for candidates based in Eastern, Central, or Mountain time zones. The anticipated base salary range for this role is $100,000 to $115,000 USD. Actual starting pay within this range will depend on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and skills relative to the role's requirements. This role is eligible for bonus compensation and participation in Kokua Education's benefits program, which includes medical/dental/vision coverage, 401k retirement plan and company match, paid time off.

This role is particularly important in supporting BorderBuddy’s growing ecommerce and high-volume clearance programs, powered by Zipments’ automation and trade technology platform.

Given the operational nature of ecommerce and parcel-level clearance, this position operates on a rolling schedule and requires flexibility to support extended service hours.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Independently reviews and prepares customs documentation for processing and entry releases.

  • Handles general inquiries (internally and externally) over the phone, through email, or on Slack.

BorderBuddy is an excellent place to develop your career. As part of the A&A Group of Companies, you will be joining a growing organization investing heavily in both brokerage excellence and the future of trade technology.

Our standard work schedule is 37.5 hours per week. This is a full-time, 100% remote role, and candidatesmust reside and work from within Canada. BorderBuddy will provide all required IT equipment to successfully perform the role.

BorderBuddy operates in a 24/7/365 environment to support ecommerce and high volume customs clearance across time zones. As a result, this is a rolling position with a predictable rotation that includes day, evening, and weekend shifts (weekend work is required on a rotating basis, typically every second weekend, with schedules planned in advance).

Shifts rotate between 9:00 am - 5:00 pm, and 3:00 pm - 11:00 pm, shared between two team members.

Candidates based in Eastern Canada are preferred to support time-zone alignment.

While we sincerely appreciate all applications, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Meet BorderBuddy:

Unlike traditional customs brokers who have been around for decades, BorderBuddy was established after the advent of the Internet - the same year Apple introduced the iPhone. Over the last 17 years, we have adeptly managed the importation of a wide array of goods, gaining the trust of over 80,000 clients and a 4.8-star rating with over 2300 Google reviews.

As part of a larger brokerage and technology group clearing over $700MM in GMV annually, BorderBuddy offers the agility of a modern ecommerce broker with the scale, expertise, and support of an established industry leader.

jobs.description:
DISCLOSURES

The specific statements shown in each section of this job description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. The company will inform the personnel member when changes in the respective job description are made.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Enterprise Management Solutions LLC (“EMS”) provides operational infrastructure, staffing, digital marketing systems, and revenue enablement services for U.S.-based companies in real estate, property management, hospitality, healthcare, and service-based industries.

As part of its Digital Marketing & Growth Division, EMS manages paid advertising systems designed to generate scalable and measurable business growth. TikTok represents a strategic expansion channel focused on short-form, creative-driven demand generation.

COMPANY WEBSITE:

COMPANY PHONE NUMBER: (667) 309-5345

HR DEPARTMENT PHONE NUMBER: (667) 309-5345 ext 10

HR DEPARTMENT EMAIL ADDRESS:

POSITION TITLE: TikTok Ads Performance Specialist

ALTERNATE TITLE(S): TikTok Performance Marketing Manager, TikTok Paid Media Specialist, Short-Form Paid Media Strategist, TikTok Growth Marketing Specialist, Performance Media Buyer – TikTok

COMPANY: Enterprise Management Solutions, LLC

DEPARTMENT: Marketing & Sales

DIVISION: Marketing & Sales

UNIT: N/A

ACCOUNTABLE TO: Chief Marketing & Sales Officer (CMSO)

ACCOUNTABLE FOR: Planning, launching, optimizing, and scaling TikTok advertising campaigns; developing structured creative testing systems; managing campaign budgets; ensuring accurate pixel and CRM tracking; analyzing performance data; and generating measurable lead and revenue growth for U.S.-based client accounts.

CLASSIFICATION: Exempt - Independent Contractor (Non-U.S.), W-8BEN

WORK SCHEDULE: Every Monday to Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. The contractor must be actively available during these hours to collaborate with leadership, media buyers, and technical teams.

COMPENSATION RANGE: $6.00 – $7.50 per hour, based on experience, creative capability, and performance impact.

BENEFITS PACKAGE: Ineligible

ANTICIPATED TRAVEL: None

SUMMARY OF POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

The TikTok Ads Performance Specialist is responsible for the strategic planning, execution, and optimization of TikTok advertising campaigns for U.S.-based client accounts.

Unlike Google Ads (intent-based) or Meta (audience-based), TikTok performance marketing is driven primarily by creative experimentation, attention capture, and rapid iteration. Success on TikTok requires an understanding of platform culture, scroll behavior psychology, hook creation, and short-form video testing methodologies.

This role focuses on creative strategy, campaign testing velocity, budget management, pixel tracking accuracy, and performance scalability.

SCHEDULED DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Campaign Strategy and Setup

  • Conduct structured intake to understand client offers, audience profiles, and KPIs.
  • Design campaign frameworks aligned with lead generation or revenue objectives.
  • Structure campaigns using appropriate objectives such as Lead Generation, Conversions, or Traffic.
  • Configure ad group segmentation based on testing methodology.
  • Launch campaigns using controlled budget allocation frameworks.

Creative Strategy and Testing Velocity

  • Develop structured creative testing plans.
  • Identify and script high-performing hooks with strong emphasis on the first three seconds.
  • Test multiple creative formats including UGC-style videos, native storytelling formats, problem-solution structures, and testimonial-based creatives.
  • Monitor creative fatigue and performance decay.
  • Analyze retention metrics and hook performance.
  • Scale high-performing creatives using structured iteration systems.

Audience Targeting and Optimization

  • Build broad targeting structures aligned with TikTok algorithm best practices.
  • Test interest-based segmentation when appropriate.
  • Monitor CPM, CTR, conversion rate, and cost per acquisition metrics.
  • Adjust bidding strategies and audience structures based on performance data.
  • Identify whether performance changes are driven by creative variables or audience structure.

Tracking and Attribution

  • Install and verify TikTok Pixel implementation.
  • Configure Events API when applicable.
  • Verify domain setup and event prioritization.
  • Align TikTok event tracking with GoHighLevel CRM capture.
  • Ensure UTM parameters are properly structured.
  • Conduct regular quality assurance checks to validate conversion accuracy and source attribution.

Budget Management and Scaling

  • Monitor daily and weekly spend pacing.
  • Maintain cost efficiency thresholds.
  • Reallocate budget toward high-performing creatives.
  • Prevent overspending during learning phases.
  • Implement structured scaling methodologies.
  • Review CRM pipeline quality to assess lead-to-revenue alignment.

CRM and Reporting Alignment

  • Ensure TikTok leads flow correctly into GoHighLevel.
  • Validate source attribution accuracy within CRM.
  • Provide structured weekly performance summaries.
  • Deliver monthly reports including spend, lead volume, cost per lead, creative performance breakdown, and scaling recommendations.

UNSCHEDULED DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Respond to urgent campaign adjustments.
  • Participate in strategic planning sessions.
  • Remain updated on TikTok platform updates and algorithm changes.
  • Support broader paid media initiatives when required.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Primarily sedentary; extended periods of computer work, campaign monitoring, and data analysis.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Remote work environment with collaboration across U.S. time zones. Requires stable internet connection, reliable computer equipment, and professional virtual communication standards.

COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS:

  • Strong understanding of short-form creative strategy and hook-based marketing psychology.
  • Proficiency in TikTok Ads Manager.
  • Experience installing TikTok Pixel and basic Events API configuration.
  • Familiarity with CRM integrations, preferably GoHighLevel.
  • Strong analytical and performance optimization skills.
  • Disciplined budget management capability.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work aligned with U.S. Eastern Time.

LEVEL OF EDUCATION / TRAINING / QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 2-4 years of hands-on TikTok Ads experience required.
  • Demonstrated experience running and optimizing lead generation campaigns.
  • Experience installing TikTok Pixel and configuring conversion tracking.
  • Understanding of short-form content trends and platform-native creative.
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients preferred.
  • Experience running Meta Ads considered a secondary but valuable skillset.
  • Reliable computer or laptop and strong, stable internet connection required.

PERFORMANCE METRICS (KPIs):

  • Performance will be evaluated based on:
  • Creative testing velocity
  • Lead volume growth
  • Cost per lead/acquisition efficiency
  • Campaign scalability
  • Budget pacing accuracy
  • Client satisfaction
Salary: $6.00 - $7.50 per hour

WHO WE ARE

As a global professional services leader, our focus remains on providing bespoke solutions that enable organisations to create the future of business and embrace change for sustainable growth, powered by a global team of over 5,000 people.

Across digital transformation, emerging technologies, SAP enterprise solutions, outsourcing, and human capital, we support organisations in building environments that operate effectively and scale with the business. Today, this extends to more than 1,500 enterprise clients, where the focus remains on creating systems that are not only functional, but ready to adapt and evolve over time.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Abacus is seeking an experienced F5 Consultant to provide high-priority, on-demand technical support during critical dress rehearsal simulations, cutover/go-live phases, and post-go-live hypercare. You will work closely with network, application, and client stakeholders to ensure seamless traffic routing, resolve real-time connectivity and configuration issues, and maintain high availability across all F5 infrastructure components.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

As an F5 Consultant, you will be responsible for:

  • Dress Rehearsal Support: Providing live on-call standby support during simulated go-live events to test and validate system behavior.
  • Traffic & Routing Optimization: Diagnosing and resolving traffic flow issues across Virtual IPs (VIPs), pools, and backend nodes while modifying routing logic, traffic distribution methods, and virtual server configurations in real-time based on test outcomes.
  • Health Monitoring & Validation: Performing hands-on configuration and validation of health monitor responses and backend server availability across environments.
  • SSL/TLS & Profile Management: Supporting SSL/TLS certificate deployments, offloading, or renewals, and fine-tuning persistence profiles and load-balancing algorithms to mirror expected production behavior.
  • End-to-End Troubleshooting: Diagnosing connectivity between F5 infrastructure, external systems, APIs, and firewalls, while thoroughly documenting any unexpected behavior.
  • Go-Live Cutover Oversight: Delivering critical real-time technical oversight during the production go-live cutover to ensure seamless operation of F5 configurations and rapid resolution of emergent incidents.
  • Post-Go-Live Support (Hypercare): Delivering dedicated post-go-live hypercare support to monitor environment stability and remediate residual performance or routing issues.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Working closely with network, application, and client teams to ensure clear communication and documentation of incident resolutions, configuration tweaks, and test outcomes.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Hands-on F5 BIG-IP Pool Management: Proven hands-on experience with F5 BIG-IP health monitoring and pool management, going well beyond conceptual knowledge.
  • F5 LTM & GTM / DNS Expertise: Proven experience configuring, managing, and troubleshooting F5 BIG-IP LTM (VIPs, pools, nodes, health monitors, persistence profiles, SSL/TLS profiles) as well as practical experience in GTM / DNS and global traffic management configuration.
  • HA Clustering & Failover: Hands-on experience with High Availability (HA) clustering and failover configuration to maintain resilient, high-availability infrastructure.
  • Network & Security Integration: Strong understanding of end-to-end traffic flow, routing logic, API integrations, and firewall interactions.
  • Consulting & Stakeholder Management: Strong client-facing consulting, communication, and stakeholder management skills, given the consulting nature of the engagement.
  • Troubleshooting: Rapid diagnostic and problem-solving capabilities for live environment issues across network and application tiers.
  • Availability & Strict SLA Commitment: Strict commitment to nighttime/early morning support hours (3:30 AM to 7:00 AM PKT) and extended pre-check periods, with a guaranteed 15-minute response time during agreed standby and go-live windows.
  • Documentation Skills: Ability to deliver clear, professional documentation of incident resolutions, configuration tweaks, and dress rehearsal outcomes.

PREFERRED / NICE TO HAVE

  • Professional F5 certifications (e.g., F5-CA, F5-CTS LTM / GTM).
  • Exposure to client-facing consulting or professional services environments.
  • Experience with enterprise cutovers, go-live simulations, and hypercare support models.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience.
  • Exposure to large-scale, enterprise-grade platform and API projects.
  • A collaborative, innovation-driven, and growth-oriented work environment.
  • Continuous learning opportunities and access to professional development resources.
  • Opportunity to work with a globally recognised professional services leader.

CoinLedger | Remote (US) | Full-Time

Build a tax firm from zero — with thousands of warm leads waiting

CoinLedger is the leading crypto tax software platform. Every year, hundreds of thousands of people use CoinLedger to calculate their crypto taxes — and every year, a huge portion of them ask us the same question: "Can you just do my whole return for me?"

We're finally saying yes. CoinLedger is launching a full-service tax preparation firm, and we're hiring one person to build it with us.

This is not a staff preparer job at an established firm. This is the founding hire. You'll work directly with CoinLedger's executive team to stand up the firm from scratch — the infrastructure, the technology, the compliance framework, the processes — and then run point on delivering returns when filing season hits.

The vision: an AI-native tax firm

There's a window in time right now to build the first generation of truly AI-native professional services firms. Not traditional practices with AI bolted on, but firms designed from day one around what modern AI can actually do. Tax prep is one of the clearest opportunities on the board, and CoinLedger is extremely well-positioned to take advantage of this.

We are predominantly a team of technologists — engineers and builders who have spent years shipping tax software at scale and who have the chops to bring an AI-native firm to life. What we're looking for is the other half of the equation: a real tax professional with the depth and knowledge to own the tax side of the house.

You bring the expertise of someone who has taken hundreds of returns from intake to e-file; we bring the engineering muscle to turn that expertise into systems. Together, we build a firm where AI handles as much of the return as it credibly can and human judgment is applied exactly where it matters most.

If you've ever looked at how your current firm operates and thought *"most of this could be automated, and nobody here is even trying"* — this role was written for you.

What you'll actually do

Year one, before filing season:

  • Work with the CoinLedger executive team to stand up the firm's legal, business, and operational structure
  • Serve as the responsible official on our EFIN application and hold signing authority as the paid preparer on client returns
  • Lead the compliance and regulatory buildout: IRC §7216 consent flows, FTC Safeguards Rule requirements, state-level registrations, and data security practices
  • Build the firm's SOPs from a blank page: intake, workpapers, review standards, e-file procedures, client communication
  • Partner with our engineering and AI teams to design the human-in-the-loop return pipeline — deciding where AI does the work, where humans verify, and how we measure quality

During filing season:

  • Prepare, review, and sign individual returns end to end — including crypto-heavy activity, Schedule C self-employment, K-1s, and multi-state filings
  • Handle client-facing communication and manage the client experience
  • Continuously feed what you learn back into the AI pipeline so every return makes the next one faster

Long term:

  • Grow into a leadership role as the firm scales — you're the first hire, not the last

Who we're looking for

Hard requirements:

  • Active EA or CPA credential in good standing
  • Willingness to serve as the signing paid preparer and EFIN responsible official — you're comfortable putting your name on the work
  • Full-cycle individual return experience: you know how to take a 1040 from intake to e-file acceptance, including Schedule C, K-1s, and multi-state returns, and you know the tools and stack of a working tax prep firm inside and out
  • Working knowledge of cryptocurrency tax reporting: capital gains/losses, cost basis methods, staking and mining income, and the realities of messy exchange data
  • Genuine fluency with modern AI tools — you actively use tools like Claude Code, Codex, and ChatGPT in your work today, and you're excited to push them further
  • US-based

About AMZ Advisers:

AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces. Working at AMZ Advisers allows you to apply your skills, expertise, and passions to directly impact the lives and business of other people and entrepreneurs. Our staff solves dynamic, quickly evolving problems with our Founders, in-house team, and network of partnered tech companies. Our Account Management team is organized into pods, consisting of Senior Account Managers (SAMs), Junior Account Managers (JAMs), and Apprentices and Interns. This structure fosters knowledge sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning.

About the Role:

We’re seeking a driven and self-motivated problem solver with exceptionally strong communication skills and the ability to build long-lasting client relationships. We offer a fast-paced, challenging, and creative environment where you will be provided the opportunity to sharpen your analytical, communication, and strategic development skills. You will be offered resources and growth opportunities to learn more about online marketing to enhance your professional career.

The ideal candidate is an independent thinker who can confidently manage multiple Amazon Seller and Vendor Central accounts while leading client relationships with a high level of ownership and professionalism. As an Account Manager, this person will be responsible for building strong strategies, guiding clients through clear and proactive communication, and ensuring their portfolio is progressing toward the right goals. They should be comfortable working closely with their Brand Strategist and cross-functional pod members, while taking the lead on day-to-day account direction, strategic execution, and client success.

This is a fully remote position. If hired, you will join a company with an amazing and talented staff.

What You’ll Do:

General Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of clients, gradually growing to approximately 10 accounts, while maintaining a high retention rate.

  • Build strong, long-term client relationships through clear, proactive, and confident communication.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring they feel informed, supported, and strategically guided at all times.

  • Set clear expectations with clients and manage those expectations throughout the lifecycle of the account.

  • Conduct regular strategy calls with clients to review performance, communicate progress, explain results, and align on upcoming priorities.

  • Build, track, and monitor KPIs for all accounts under personal portfolio management.

  • Conduct audits of client accounts and use data to identify opportunities, blockers, and areas for improvement.

  • Develop strategic growth plans tailored to each client’s goals, lifecycle stage, and account conditions.

  • Proactively identify and recommend strategies to improve account performance across sales, traffic, conversion, profitability, inventory, content, and advertising.

  • Report on account progress, key action items, and next-step priorities in a clear and organized way.

  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee promotions, launches, and marketplace initiatives in alignment with the broader account strategy.

  • Coordinate the resolution of account issues by working with internal teams and escalating through the appropriate channels when needed.

  • Use internal and external software tools to analyze account performance and support strategy development.

  • Work cross-functionally with Ads, Specialists, Content, Onboarding, and Strategists to ensure strategies are executed effectively and aligned to client goals.

  • Attend Account Management meetings, trainings, and ongoing development sessions on a weekly or bi-weekly basis.

  • Participate in daily stand-up meetings to raise blockers, align on priorities, and maintain execution momentum.

Strategy Ownership

  • Conduct account audits and turn findings into clear, actionable strategies.

  • Build client strategies based on data, marketplace trends, account health, business goals, and realistic opportunity areas.

  • Understand how to prioritize focus SKUs based on performance, profitability, traffic potential, conversion, and growth opportunity.

  • Adjust strategies as needed based on data, seasonality, competitive changes, and evolving client objectives.

  • Ensure every recommendation has a clear reason behind it and can be explained confidently to the client.

Advertising & Amazon Knowledge

  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of Amazon as a whole, including traffic, conversion, listing quality, profitability, inventory, account health, and category dynamics.

  • Understand Amazon advertising strategy well enough to contribute meaningfully to planning, decision-making, and client communication.

  • Be able to interpret ad performance, identify high-level opportunities or inefficiencies, and connect advertising decisions to the broader business strategy.

  • Work closely with the Ads team and Strategist to align ad direction with overall account goals, whether those goals are growth, profitability, ranking, launch velocity, or market share.

  • Communicate ad strategy and performance to clients in a way that is clear, accurate, and tied back to business outcomes.

Pod Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Brand Strategist within the pod to refine account strategy, validate recommendations, and escalate higher-level concerns when needed.

  • Collaborate with pod members regularly through meetings, brainstorming sessions, and strategy discussions.

  • Keep internal teams aligned by ensuring priorities, deadlines, and strategic direction are clearly communicated.

  • Support a collaborative pod environment where ideas, blockers, and opportunities are surfaced early.

Client Communication & Relationship Management

  • Lead proactive, transparent, and solutions-oriented communication with clients.

  • Build trust by not only reporting on what happened, but clearly explaining why it happened, what it means, and what should happen next.

  • Be able to handle difficult conversations, performance concerns, and conflicting client goals with confidence and professionalism.

  • Guide clients toward the right strategic decisions, even when those decisions require pushback or expectation resetting.

  • Ensure clients feel that their accounts are being actively managed, thoughtfully reviewed, and strategically guided.

  • Encourage client feedback and use it to strengthen the relationship and improve the service experience.

  • Help identify retention risks early and take action before they become larger client issues.

Check-ins, Accountability & Growth Opportunities

  • Regularly review account progress and raise issues, risks, or missed opportunities early.

  • Stay proactive in identifying upsell and expansion opportunities where appropriate.

  • Take ownership of account outcomes and maintain strong follow-through on action items.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve account performance, internal processes, and the client experience.

How We’ll Measure Success

  • Retention Rate - Percentage of retained clients from month to month.

  • Blocker/ Conflict Resolution Time - Monitor and decrease the time taken to resolve client issues or blockers.

  • Client Communication - Assess the quality and frequency of client interactions for improved satisfactions.

  • Strategy Effectiveness - Evaluate the success of client strategies considering feedback and performance metrics.

Qualifications:

  • BA in Marketing, Business Development, Management, or other related studies.

  • 2+ years with client account management.

  • 2+ years digital marketing or eCommerce experience.

  • 1+ year experience with Amazon Seller and or Vendor Central.

  • Ability to build and maintain client relations.

  • Active listening and the ability to understand client needs.

  • Proactive, go-getter mindset who functions well within a team setting but can work independently.

  • Strong ability to think outside the box, willingness to test new ideas, and develop and implement growth strategies.

  • Strong time management skills and the ability to multitask.

  • Ability and desire to learn new skills.

Technologies We Use:

  • G-Suite: Gmail, Google Drive, Google Meets, Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides

  • Microsoft: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

  • ClickUp

  • Nordpass

  • Slack

  • Sellerboard

  • Data Dive

  • Zoom

The E-Volunteer’s Role

Volunteer your business engagement and digital marketing expertise remotely to help create more inclusive economic opportunities in Colombia. As an e-volunteer with Cuso International, you will support outreach to companies, contribute to digital engagement strategies, and help build partnerships that expand pathways to formal employment and self-employment for women, youth, victims of armed conflict, migrants, refugees, and other communities facing barriers to participation.

This remote opportunity is ideal for a strategic communicator and relationship builder who wants to apply professional skills to meaningful social impact. Working virtually with Cuso International colleagues and local stakeholders, you will research prospective partners, strengthen diagnostic tools, develop tailored proposals, and provide practical implementation support. Your contribution will help organizations advance more inclusive practices while giving you the opportunity to share your expertise in an international development context.

As an e-volunteer, you will support the organization through the following activities:

  • Conduct remote market research, map prospective partners, segment priority audiences, and recommend targeted outreach approaches.
  • Review and strengthen the initial diagnostic tool, providing clear insights and practical recommendations for partner organizations.
  • Develop compelling, customized proposals that connect organizational needs with inclusive employment and business solutions.
  • Provide virtual guidance to companies and project stakeholders as they implement approved proposals, monitor progress, and work toward sustainable results.

Essential Requirements:

  • A degree in marketing, business administration, data analysis, communications, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Spanish. disciplines are an asset

Essential Background:

  • Experience in strategic communications and institutional positioning.
  • A track record of building relationships with private- and public-sector organizations; experience working with Canadian companies is an asset.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and implement digital marketing strategies that engage targeted audiences.
  • Experience with social organizations, social-impact projects, or inclusion initiatives is preferred.
  • Hands-on knowledge of LinkedIn, digital campaigns, social media platforms, and performance analytics.

About E-Volunteering

Make a global impact right from your home! With Cuso International's e-volunteering program, you can collaborate with diverse partners and local volunteers, contribute to meaningful projects, and enhance your professional skills, all while maintaining a flexible schedule. E-volunteers should have basic home office equipment, a reliable internet connection, and moderate computer skills. If you're volunteering with partners in remote areas where internet access is limited, it's important to demonstrate flexibility and patience.

Broaden your horizons and make a difference by joining Cuso International's e-volunteering program today!

About Us, the Project and the Partner

Cuso International (Cuso) is an international cooperation and development organization based in Canada that works to create social and economic opportunities for equity-deserving groups. Building on over sixty years of impactful work, we address global challenges by tackling the root causes of inequality. Working alongside our partners, we are focused on efforts to improve economic resilience, advance equity and inclusion for all, and deliver progress on climate action. We believe that by sharing skills, we can build better futures. Guided by our values of courage, inclusion, sustainability and accountability, Cuso combines innovative strategies and enduring partnerships to create lasting, meaningful change in communities across Africa, Latin America, the Caribbean, and Canada.

jobs.description:
​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: US Customer Support Specialist (voice + email), US hours

Compensation range: $ 1,900 USD - $ 2,400 USD / Monthly

Engagement type: Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: Full time · Night shift on US hours (about 9pm–6am Manila, adjusted for US daylight saving)

The first 2–4 weeks are on the Australian day shift for training, then they move to US hours.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is:

We are an Australian company specialising in the design and supply of rainwater, gutter protection and plumbing products. We support customers across a range of residential and trade-related needs, with a strong focus on responsive service, reliable products and efficient order fulfilment. Our team is growing, and we’re looking for someone who can help keep customer requests and operational follow-ups moving smoothly.

Role Overview:

Be the voice of a growing Australian brand for its US customers, and work with AI every day.

We’re looking for a US Customer Support Specialist to become the dedicated point of contact for our growing US customer base.

Our client is an Australian company that designs and supplies rainwater harvesting, gutter guard and plumbing products to customers and trade businesses internationally. In this role, you’ll support US distributors, tank manufacturers and trade customers throughout their working day, making sure questions are answered, orders stay on track, and customers receive updates before they need to follow up.

This is a hands-on customer support role combining voice, email, order coordination and logistics follow-through. You’ll also work closely with a US-based warehouse partner and use AI tools every day to help you work efficiently and accurately.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Answer US customer emails and tickets in US hours: order status, tracking, PO acknowledgements, documents, account questions
  • Work live with our US 3PL in Houston: stock holds, paperwork, resupply, carrier issues, parcel invoice queries
  • Watch every US order in transit and update customers before they chase
  • Make outbound calls in a set daily block: callbacks, order queries, delivery updates, quote follow-ups; over time, regular calls to US trade and distributor accounts
  • Take US inbound calls once trained (currently low volume)
  • Handle South Africa and UK afternoon tickets
  • Triage overnight Australian tickets and write a ranked handover note for our 7am start
  • Use AI and our systems to draft replies and find answers, and flag where the AI gets it wrong

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

Must have:

  • Previous US customer support experience, including voice support — chat-only experience will not be sufficient
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Strong phone communication and confidence speaking with customers
  • Highly organised and self-directed, particularly when working independently
  • Comfortable working US hours and managing priorities with minimal supervision
  • Experience using ticketing systems, business systems and/or AI tools
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to produce clear, structured handover notes
  • A proactive approach to customer service — you don’t just respond to problems; you follow things through

Nice to have:

  • Experience in logistics, freight, warehousing or order fulfilment
  • Experience with building, plumbing, rainwater or related trade products
  • Experience with Zendesk, Aircall or Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
  • Experience supporting distributor, wholesale or trade customers

AI Is Part of the Job

You’ll use AI as part of your everyday workflow. Tools such as Claude and the company’s internal operating system help you find information, draft responses and keep track of tasks.

We’re not looking for someone who simply relies on AI. We want someone who can use AI effectively while applying good judgement — checking information, spotting when something doesn’t look right, and knowing when a customer issue needs human attention.

Working Hours

This is a US-hours role, aligned with the working day of the company’s US customers and warehouse partner.

You’ll work remotely from the Philippines while providing dedicated support during US business hours.

Application Requirements

As part of your application, please provide:

  1. A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself and briefly discussing your customer support experience.
  2. An example of an AI tool you currently use or have used at work, including how you use it and what it helps you accomplish.

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

jobs.description:
Vālenz Health® is the destination for employers, brokers, payers, and providers to reduce costs, improve quality, and elevate the healthcare experience. Through advanced technology and clinical expertise, Valenz creates a distinctly different approach to a complex healthcare system. With our solutions, we execute across the entire healthcare journey — from member experience to payment integrity, provider quality, and plan performance. With one of America’s largest cost, quality and utilization datasets, we create greater transparency, flexibility, and cost containment — empowering members and employers with the information they need to make smarter, more cost-effective decisions.

About This Opportunity:
As a Document Retrieval Specialist (aka Intake Coordinator for Bill Review), you’ll support the Bill Review process by accurately entering, reviewing, and validating healthcare claim information and supporting documentation. You’ll serve as an initial quality checkpoint, ensuring claims are complete, accurate, properly documented, and ready for downstream review and processing. You’ll also research discrepancies, obtain missing documentation or provider information as needed, and maintain accurate records while meeting established productivity, quality, and turnaround expectations.

Things You’ll Do Here:

  • Enters and maintains healthcare claim information in internal systems, including patient demographics, provider information, claim details, diagnosis and procedure codes, charges, dates of service, and supporting documentation.
  • Reviews incoming claims and documentation for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before advancing information through the Bill Review process.
  • Validates entered data against source documents and performs quality checks to identify and correct errors before downstream processing.
  • Identifies missing, incomplete, duplicate, or conflicting claim information and follows established procedures to resolve or escalate discrepancies.
  • Researches claim and provider discrepancies using available systems, reports, documentation, and other appropriate resources.
  • Contacts healthcare providers as needed to obtain missing documentation and verify provider information necessary to complete claim intake.
  • Maintains accurate claim records, notes, and supporting documentation, including corrections, information requests, and actions taken.
  • Updates records when corrected or additional information is received and ensures changes are accurately reflected within applicable systems.
  • Applies working knowledge of healthcare terminology and claim data elements, including ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, revenue codes, and related billing information.
  • Follows established workflows, standard operating procedures, client requirements, and processing guidelines when completing claim intake activities.
  • Tracks completed and outstanding work to ensure assignments are processed within established service levels and turnaround times.
  • Meets established productivity and quality expectations while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Communicates with internal teams when missing information, discrepancies, or other issues may affect downstream claim processing.
  • Identifies recurring data or process issues and communicates trends to leadership to support accuracy, efficiency, and process improvement.
  • Participates in training and ongoing education related to healthcare claims, systems, client requirements, procedures, and regulatory standards.
  • Maintains confidentiality of protected health information and complies with HIPAA, privacy, security, and organizational requirements.
Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential duties.


What You’ll Bring to the Team:
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • 1+ years of data entry or claims-processing experience required.
  • Strong data entry skills with demonstrated accuracy, attention to detail, and ability to work effectively with high volumes of information.
  • Strong research, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and resolve routine discrepancies.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to prioritize work and meet productivity, quality, and turnaround expectations.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate professionally with healthcare providers and internal teams.
  • Proficiency with computer systems and Microsoft Office applications and the ability to quickly learn healthcare claims and workflow systems.
  • Ability to work independently, follow established procedures, and appropriately escalate issues requiring additional review.
  • Ability to handle confidential healthcare information with discretion and maintain compliance with HIPAA and applicable privacy requirements.

A plus if you have…
  • Previous experience working within healthcare, medical billing, claims, provider services, healthcare administration, or a related environment.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare terminology and claim information, including familiarity with ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, revenue codes, billed charges, and other healthcare data elements.
  • Familiarity with healthcare provider information, billing terminology, and common claim documentation.
  • Experience working in healthcare cost containment, medical bill review, payment integrity, TPA, health plan, or related healthcare services.


Where You’ll Work: This is a fully remote position, and we’ll provide all the necessary equipment!

  • Work Environment: You’ll need a quiet workspace that is free from distractions.
  • Technology: Reliable internet connection—if you can use streaming services, you’re good to go!
  • Security: Adherence to company security protocols, including the use of VPNs, secure passwords, and company-approved devices/software.
  • Location: You must be US based, in a location where you can work effectively and comply with company policies such as HIPAA.

Why You'll Love Working Here

Our mission is to advance healthcare through technology and expertise to optimize cost, quality, access, and utilization for all. We bring that mission to life through our commitment to Collaboration, Performance, Transparency, and Trust—the core values that guide how we work with our members, our customers, and each other.

Benefits

  • 401K with company match and immediate vesting

jobs.description:
deine mission

Wir sind ein wachsendes PropTech-Startup aus Münster. Unsere KI-gestützte Software ist die Entscheidungsgrundlage für die Immobilienentwicklung. Projektentwickler, Bestandshalter, Banken und Makler nutzen syte, um in Sekunden zu entscheiden, ob, was und wo gebaut, saniert oder gekauft wird. Ausgezeichnet wurden wir mit dem Deutschen KI-Preis 2023 und dem PropTech of the Year Award 2025 des ZIA (Zentraler Immobilien Ausschuss). Heute bildet unsere Plattform auf Basis von über 300 Terabyte Geodaten digitale Zwillinge für 62 Millionen Gebäude und Grundstücke in Deutschland ab.

Für den nächsten Sprung, von unseren heutigen Gebäudemodellen zum texturierten LoD3-Gebäude, suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Senior Computer Vision / Photogrammetry Engineer (m/w/d) in Münster oder deutschlandweit remote.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Alle Quellen in einem Modell vereinen: Du kombinierst 2D-Katasterdaten, LiDAR-Punktwolken, Schrägluftbilder, Nadir-Satellitenbilder und weitere Quellen zur genauestmöglichen Abbildung der realen Welt.
  • Unsere 3D-Modelle verbessern: Du bringst Bilddaten und moderne 3D-Rekonstruktionsverfahren in das Produkt, von Multi-View Stereo bis zu Methoden wie Gaussian Splatting und verbesserst damit unsere Gebäudemodelle erheblich.
  • Texturiertes LoD3 erreichen: Du texturierst unsere Modelle aus Schrägluftbildern und erkennst Fenster, Türen und Fassadenelemente. Diese projizierst du konsistent auf die richtige Fläche des richtigen Gebäudes, damit Geschossflächen, Nutzflächen und Oberflächen deutlich präziser berechnet werden können.
  • Mehr aus den Bildern herausholen: Du implementierst Methoden wie Multi-Image Super-Resolution und Occlusion-Aware Reconstruction. So überwindest du begrenzte Bildauflösung und Verdeckungen durch Bäume und andere Objekte.
  • Forschung in die Produktion bringen: Gemeinsam mit unseren Data Engineers, die Pipelines und Plattform verantworten, skalierst du Methoden von einer Handvoll Gebäude auf Millionen.
  • AI-native entwickeln: Du nutzt das volle Potenzial moderner AI-Coding-Tools wie Claude Code und Copilot und identifizierst proaktiv neue KI-Use-Cases im Kontext von Computer Vision und 3D-Rekonstruktion.

dein profil

  • Ausbildung: Masterabschluss in einem technischen Fach (z. B. Informatik, Geoinformationssysteme, Geoinformatik, Physik, Mathematik).
  • Erfahrung: Mindestens vier Jahre Praxis- oder Forschungserfahrung (z. B. Promotion, wissenschaftliche Mitarbeit) im Bereich (urbane) 3D-Rekonstruktion, Computer Vision und Photogrammetrie, inklusive der Entwicklung funktionierender Produkte oder Prototypen.
  • Photogrammetrie: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Photogrammetrie und Fernerkundung: Sensor- und Kameramodelle, Kalibrierung sowie innere und äußere Orientierung. Praktische Erfahrung darin, Airborne-LiDAR und Luftbilder zu metrisch belastbaren, georeferenzierten Daten zu kombinieren.
  • Computer Vision: Starker Hintergrund in geometrischer und 3D-Computer-Vision: Structure-from-Motion, Dense Multi-View Stereo und Punktwolkenverarbeitung. Praktische Erfahrung darin, aus Punktwolken und Bildern Gebäudemodelle zu erzeugen.
  • Tech-Stack: Sicherer Umgang mit Python, insbesondere mit den relevanten Bibliotheken (NumPy, SciPy, PDAL, GDAL, OGR etc.).
  • Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest gern im Team und hast Erfahrung mit Versionsverwaltung (Git).
  • Interesse an der Domäne: Du hast Lust, in den anspruchsvollen PropTech-Bereich einzutauchen. Erfahrung in PropTech, Architektur oder Immobilienwirtschaft ist ein Plus.
  • Lernbereitschaft: Du willst in einem schnell wachsenden Startup schnell wachsen, echten Impact haben und technologisch vorne bleiben, besonders bei Cloud-Technologien und KI.
  • Sprache: Du sprichst fließend Englisch (mind. C1 Niveau).

cherry on top

  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Technologien, idealerweise Google Cloud Platform.
  • Deutsche Sprachkenntnisse sind ein Plus

dein einstiegstermin und einsatzort

  • Einstiegstermin: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt
  • Einsatzort: Münster oder deutschlandweit remote

deine benefits

  • Dein attraktives Gehalt: Wir sorgen dafür, dass jeder Aspekt deiner Reise bei syte motivierend ist. Wir kennen deinen Wert!

  • Deine Hardware: Unser syte-Team ist mit modernster Hard- und Software ausgestattet.

  • Dein Team: Einmal im Quartal trifft sich das gesamte Team für zwei Tage zum Arbeiten und um gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern.

  • Deine Flexibilität: Neben gemeinsamen Workations hast du auch privat die Möglichkeit, aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.

  • Dein Hund im Büro: Dein vierbeiniger Begleiter ist bei uns herzlich willkommen und darf jederzeit mit dir ins Office kommen.

  • Dein persönliches Benefit-Budget: 2.200,00 € jährlich für das, was dir wichtig ist:

    • Upskilling: Dir steht jeweils ein Budget für betriebliche als auch für private Weiterbildung zur Verfügung.

    • Equipment: Neben der initialen Ausstattung mit modernster Apple-Hardware erhältst du zusätzlich ein Budget für die Ausstattung deines Arbeitsplatzes.

    • Steueroptimierte Benefits: Du kannst dein Budget u. a. für steueroptimierte Angebote wie den steuerfreien Sachbezug, einen Internet-Zuschuss, den Mobilitäts-Zuschuss, eine Erholungsbeihilfe oder einen KITA-Zuschuss nutzen.

    • Gesundheit & Wellbeing: Dein Budget kannst du zudem für alles einsetzen, was Körper und Geist guttut, so z. B. für eine Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Physiotherapie, Urlaubsreisen etc.

The ideal Inside Sales Representative is a proactive, autonomous sales professional who thrives in a fast‑paced, high‑accountability environment. They balance disciplined, process‑driven execution with strong relationship‑building skills, communicating confidently with customers and suppliers while managing complex requirements with accuracy and urgency. This person is detail‑oriented, tech‑savvy, and skilled at diagnosing needs, influencing decisions, and driving quotes to orders, all while maintaining exceptional organization, compliance, and customer satisfaction.

Position Summary

  • The Inside Sales Representative (ISR) is a revenue‑generating sales professional responsible for driving profitable growth across TEVET’s Aerospace, Defense, and Government accounts. ISRs own their book of business end‑to‑end managing all quoting activity, engaging proactively with customers and suppliers, and ensuring accuracy, compliance, and the success of every transaction.
  • This role is highly customer‑facing and requires strong communication, consistent outbound calling, disciplined pipeline management, and the ability to deliver fast, accurate responses in a complex, high‑accountability environment. ISRs diagnose customer needs, impact purchasing decisions, strengthen long‑term relationships, and resolve issues across Sales, Supply Chain, Quality, and Operations.
  • ISRs work closely with Account Managers (AMs), who focus on strategic penetration, long‑term growth, and high‑level account development. While AMs drive expansion and broader relationship strategy, ISRs own the transactional engine managing supplier interactions, customer requirements, documentation, pricing accuracy, compliance, and the quote‑to‑order process
  • ISRs serve as subject matter experts for their assigned accounts and may coach peers or provide backup coverage to ensure continuity of service. They play a critical role in protecting revenue, maintaining compliance, and upholding TEVET’s Quality Management System (QMS).

Account Ownership & Revenue Growth

  • Own the full quote‑to‑order lifecycle, including creation, revisions, follow‑ups, and margin protection.

Customer & Supplier Engagement

  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with buyers, procurement teams, engineers, and supplier partners.
  • Proactively call customers to confirm requirements, influence decisions, overcome objections, and drive quote‑to‑order conversion.
  • Proactively call suppliers to confirm pricing, lead time, technical details, and resolve issues.
  • Deliver high‑quality communication (email, phone, portals) with a strong bias for speed, accuracy, and professionalism.

RFQ, Compliance, & Documentation Management

  • Manage RFQs, clarify specifications, validate documentation, and ensure all requirements are met.
  • Ensure strict compliance with quality clauses, flow‑downs, contractual obligations, and QMS standards.
  • Escalate risks early and document resolutions clearly and accurately.

Cross‑Functional Coordination & Issue Resolution

  • Partner with Account Managers to confirm pricing, terms, and delivery commitments.
  • Resolve issues across Sales, Supply Chain, Quality, and Operations related to lead times, quality requirements, invoices, discrepancies, or compliance barriers.
  • Protect customer satisfaction and ensure continuity of support during absences through cross‑coverage.

CRM & Process Excellence

  • Maintain accurate, timely CRM documentation, logging calls, notes, meetings, tasks, next steps, and opportunity updates.
  • Use CRM reports and dashboards to manage workload, prioritize follow‑ups, and support data‑driven decision making.
  • Contribute to continuous process improvements for quoting, documentation, communication, and customer experience.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree, pursuing a degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 3+ years in customer service or sales roles; 5+ years preferred in B2B or Government/Prime Contractor environments.
  • Experience with FAR/DFARS or Government contracting strongly preferred.

Skills & Abilities

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong phone presence comfortable with talk‑time and proactive outreach.
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts, competing priorities, and tight deadlines.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills with the ability to navigate gray areas and make sound decisions.
  • Understanding procurement, contracting, and basic accounting concepts.
  • High attention to detail, accuracy, and organization in a fast‑moving environment
  • Team-oriented with willingness to mentor, support peers, and collaborate across departments.

Technical Proficiency

  • 3+ years of CRM experience (HubSpot preferred).
  • Proficiency in Outlook, Excel, Word, and PDF tools.

Work Environment

PRIMARY PURPOSE: The Vice President, Generative (Gen) AI Engineering Enterprise, provides executive leadership, strategic direction, and accountability for the enterprise data and AI engineering ecosystem that enables the organization’s most advanced analytics, data science, and generative AI initiatives. This role owns the vision, governance, and execution model for the enterprise data supply chain that powers machine learning platforms, feature stores, and production‑grade generative AI capabilities.


As a senior leader, the Vice President establishes and scales the engineering strategy required to transform legacy and modern data assets into trusted, AI‑ready enterprise capabilities. The role ensures that data and AI engineering investments are aligned to business outcomes, regulatory expectations, and long‑term architectural sustainability across on‑premise and multi‑cloud environments, including Snowflake and AWS/Azure AI ecosystems.

  • Defines and leads the enterprise strategy for data and generative AI engineering, establishing standards, roadmaps, and operating models that support analytics, machine learning, and AI at scale.
  • Provides executive oversight for the design, delivery, and operation of enterprise ETL/ELT platforms that integrate legacy on‑premise systems (including mainframe, SQL Server, and DB2) with modern cloud data and AI platforms.
  • Establishes governance and accountability for feature stores, analytically optimized datasets, and AI‑ready data products to ensure reproducibility, regulatory compliance, and production reliability.

  • Establishes executive‑level operating metrics and financial discipline to ensure data and AI engineering investments deliver measurable business value and return on investment.
  • Provides leadership and direction to engineering leaders and teams, setting priorities, removing organizational barriers, and ensuring consistent execution across portfolios and initiatives.
  • Serves as a senior advisor to executive leadership on data, AI, and generative AI capabilities, risks, and opportunities, translating technical complexity into business‑level insights and decisions.

    • Lead AI engineering for enterprise functions including HR, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and other corporate functions.
    • Identify and deliver high-value LLM, agentic AI, workflow automation, and knowledge-assistant use cases.
    • Build reusable AI capabilities, agents, APIs, connectors, and workflow integrations rather than isolated point solutions.
    • Own the enterprise administration and operational management of ChatGPT Enterprise and Claude.
    • Manage user access, licenses, roles, permissions, workspaces, and enterprise configuration for these platforms.
    • Establish and manage approved connectors and integrations to enterprise data and applications.
    • Partner with Security, Privacy, Legal, and AI Governance to define appropriate access controls and data-use guardrails.
    • Establish standards for enterprise use of GPTs, agents, projects, connectors, and other platform capabilities.
    • Monitor adoption, utilization, license consumption, token/API usage, and overall platform effectiveness.
    • Partner closely with Finance and Procurement to manage AI platform spend, forecasting, chargeback/showback, license optimization, and vendor commitments.
