About Engine

At Engine, we’re transforming business travel into something personalized, rewarding, and simple. For too long, managing travel and spend has been overwhelming and fragmented — we’re here to change that. We believe the future of travel should be seamless and powered by technology that delights customers at every step. That’s why we’re building a platform that brings together corporate travel, a powerful charge card, and modern spend management in one place.

To make this vision real, we’re looking for exceptional, mission-driven people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel.

More than 30,000 companies already rely on Engine to support over 1 million travelers and billions in annual bookings each year. Cash flow positive with rapid growth, we pair exclusive Engine-only rates, industry-leading rewards, and intelligent automation to help businesses save money while delivering world-class personalization and convenience.

Backed by Telescope Partners, Blackstone, and Permira, Engine has been recognized as one of the fastest-growing travel and fintech platforms in North America, with honors including the Deloitte Fast 500 and Built In’s Best Places to Work.

About the Role:

Engine is a high-growth, multi-entity travel marketplace with multiple revenue streams, international operations, a company-branded charge card, and a disciplined 5-day close. Accounting here already runs lean and AI-forward.

We are hiring a Controller to take it to the next level of excellence, building on the automation and AI already in place and scaling a modern close through Engine’s next phase of growth.

This is not a maintenance role. We are looking for a decisive, high-judgment leader who can raise talent density, simplify how work gets done, and push our existing AI and automation further to create real operating leverage. The goal is not to build a larger function. It is to build a better one.

You will report to the VP, Accounting and lead the core Accounting leadership team, including Assistant Controller / GL, AR and, Payroll, and Tax. The role has a meaningful runway to grow into broader scope as Engine grows.

Your Mission

Own the operating system of Engine’s accounting function: the talent bar, the integrity of the close, the control environment, and the pace of automation, so a lean team scales with the business without scaling headcount.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Raise the operating bar: Create a clearer, more accountable operating model across Accounting. Clarify decision rights, push ownership closer to the work, reduce unnecessary escalation, and move priorities quickly from discussion to execution.
  • Increase talent density: Build a high-performing leadership team that operates with strong judgment and increasing independence. Set a clear performance bar, develop strong managers, address capability gaps directly, and make thoughtful talent upgrades where needed.
  • Scale AI and automation: Build on the automation and AI already in place across Accounting and take it further. Partner with Systems and cross-functional teams to automate high-volume and repetitive work, apply AI to reconciliations, documentation, anomaly detection, and management visibility, and ensure headcount grows slower than transaction volume and business complexity.
  • Modernize the close: Take an already-disciplined 5-day close and make it cleaner, faster, and less manual. Strengthen ownership across revenue, AR, payroll, tax, consolidations, reconciliations, and reporting. Remove recurring friction, simplify review layers, and fix root causes.
  • Make decisions at speed: Serve as a senior decision-maker across complex accounting and operational issues. Make well-reasoned calls with imperfect information, document the rationale, and keep the organization moving. Bring strong technical accounting depth without allowing complexity to become a reason for delay.
  • Drive cross-functional execution: Create clarity where ownership is fragmented, surface tradeoffs, make recommendations, and drive work to resolution across Product, Finance, Tax, Legal, Credit, Fraud, Sales, People, and Systems.
  • Prepare Accounting for the next phase: Build the leadership depth, systems, processes, and controls required to support increasing transaction volume, new revenue streams, international expansion, card receivables, rewards, supplier economics, intercompany activity, and FX. Anticipate where today’s processes will break at tomorrow’s scale and address those constraints early.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive accounting leadership, including Controller, Assistant Controller, or equivalent responsibility in a high-growth environment. CPA strongly preferred.
  • Track Record: A history of improving an established accounting function, not just maintaining one.
  • Talent Leadership: Proven ability to act as a talent magnet, improving the talent bar, developing the team, and building leadership depth.
  • Automation & AI: An AI-native, automation-forward operating style, with demonstrated success reducing manual work and creating measurable operating leverage.
  • Technical Accounting: Strong multi-entity close, consolidation, reconciliation, and financial statement experience, with depth across ASC 606 (gross-versus-net and principal-agent analysis), ASC 842, ASC 718, reserves, and other judgment-heavy areas.
  • Judgment & Pace: Strong judgment and decisive pace; comfortable making calls with incomplete information and operating strategically while staying close to execution.

Nice to Have:

  • Travel, marketplace, fintech, payments, card-program, or high-volume transaction accounting experience.
  • Card receivables, rewards, supplier economics, merchant and agency models, or complex revenue streams.
  • International experience, including intercompany, FX, VAT/GST, transfer-pricing support, or statutory reporting.
  • NetSuite and modern close, reconciliation, workflow, BI, automation, and AI tools.

What Success Looks Like:

Within the first 6 to 12 months:

  • The close is less dependent on manual intervention.
  • Automation and AI improvements are tied to measurable capacity, accuracy, and cycle-time gains.
  • Cross-functional issues move to resolution faster.
  • The function absorbs greater complexity without proportional headcount growth.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, total compensation may include equity and/or variable pay (OTE). Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

$199,000—$260,000 USD

Forward Deployed Engineer (Data, ML & AI)

Location: Remote Timezone: NA/Eastern Type: Full-time Experience: 10+ Years

Role Overview

This position requires a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) specializing in Data, Machine Learning, and AI to embed directly within customer environments. You will serve as the primary technical authority transforming complex data challenges and operational bottlenecks into production-grade data pipelines, machine learning systems, and agentic AI solutions.

The role is heavily customer-facing: you will work alongside client business units and engineering teams to rapidly assess legacy data estates, build scalable modern data platforms, and deploy custom GenAI/LLM workflows that drive measurable business velocity. This is a high-ownership, hands-on role where you will leverage Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and AI-assisted workflows to build, refactor, and demonstrate immediate value directly where the customer operates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Customer Embedding & Data Delivery: Deploy directly into customer environments to understand their domain logic, underlying data pipelines, and architectural constraints. Own end-to-end delivery—from data discovery and schema design to pipeline deployment and model integration—building trust as the customer's lead technical partner.
  • Data Platform & Architectural Modernization: Partner with client business leaders to evaluate legacy technology estates (e.g., monolithic SQL databases, or unmaintained ETL jobs). Lead engineering efforts to refactor legacy data setups into modern lakehouses, event-driven streaming systems, and scalable vector/graph databases.
  • Spec-Driven Development (SDD) for Data & AI: Apply a "spec-first" engineering workflow using Generative AI tools. Write structured specifications (data models, API schemas, transformations, and evaluation metrics) that instruct AI agents to generate production data models, PySpark jobs, data pipelines, and test suites.
  • Agentic AI & LLMOps Implementation: Architect and deploy GenAI workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and autonomous AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or DSPy. Establish robust evaluation frameworks (Evals) for model accuracy, latency, and hallucination control.
  • Production MLOps & Orchestration: Build, deploy, and maintain robust ML training and inference pipelines using tools like MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, or Dagster. Ensure continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) for models and data workflows.
  • Polyglot Data Engineering: Design and audit production code across data-centric languages and frameworks (Python, SQL, Scala, Go, Rust, or TypeScript) based on speed, concurrency, and memory requirements.
  • Client Enablement & Knowledge Transfer: Elevate customer teams by establishing reusable agentic development patterns, modern MLOps practices, data reliability frameworks, and SDD methodologies so systems remain maintainable long after deployment.

Requirements

  • 10+ Years of Experience: Proven track record as a Principal Data Engineer, Lead ML Engineer, or Enterprise Data Architect building and scaling distributed data and ML platforms.
  • Customer-Facing Aptitude: Strong executive presence and communication skills to interface directly with technical teams and business stakeholders under pressure.
  • Data & ML Engineering Depth:
    • Data Infrastructure: Mastery of distributed computing (AWS Glue, Apache Spark, Databricks), modern data warehouses (Redshift, Snowflake, modeling tools (dbt), and data orchestration (Airflow, etc)
    • AI/ML & Vector Architecture: Hands-on experience fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying LLMs, embedding models, and vector stores
    • Polyglot & Framework Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Python and complex SQL, plus fluency in at least two other languages used in modern backend/data systems (e.g., Scala, Go, Rust, TypeScript).
  • Generative AI & SDD Experience: Demonstrated skill in using natural language and structured specs to guide AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in generating data pipelines, schemas, and API adapters.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with cloud-native data services on AWS or Azure, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Willingness to Travel: Comfort with occasional travel to customer sites as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in a Forward Deployed Engineer, Data Architect, or technical consulting/professional services role.
  • Experience migrating legacy, on-premise data warehouses or legacy Hadoop estates to modern cloud lakehouses.
  • Deep understanding of data governance, security compliance (HIPAA, SOC2, GDPR), and privacy-preserving machine learning.

Compensation & Perks

  • Retirement Savings Matching Program (RRSP)

  • Partnership with Perkopolis Discounts

  • Paid parental leave options

Health & Wellness

  • Employer paid health & dental premiums
  • GreenShield+ Counselling Mental Health
  • $500 in Health Care Spending Account annually

jobs.title: Vigilant IT Security Manager - Portugal
jobs.excerpt: This is not an offshoring back-office job for an international company.
jobs.description:
This is not an offshoring back-office job for an international company. You will be a key player in our globally distributed team.

We’re searching for a Vigilant IT Security Manager to help us get our IT security systems up to spec, secure our networks and keep the vital organs of our team working! If you like solving complex business problems, and are experienced in all things IT security,we need you!

Read on!

(this will be a long write up but we like to give you all the details before you spend your time applying)

We are Laminar Projects!

We are an award winning consultancy that implements technology to improve the delivery of complex construction projects. Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Watch our short film about it)

We also have a separate product team, Shape Construction, that takes the deep understanding of the projects we work on to develop construction management software products.

The core of all this is our true secret sauce; people. We only recruit kind and authentic people who are fast learners. We are deeply focused on designing a new type of place that is optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. This approach has allowed us to grow from just 2 people in 2017 to over 170 today and we are still very much at the beginning! Joining us isn’t just some “job,” we challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life.

Our vision is designed to align how we operate with the fundamental aspects that enable anyone to have a fulfilled life: 

  • Connects us with meaningful relationships
  • Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans
  • Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures

4 core values for a good life

We believe a life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships with others and challenging yourself to create a positive impact. Our four core values are grow yourself, care about people, execute to greatness and build civilisation. This philosophy goes much deeper and you can see more on our website.

We are achieving this vision through the following two missions:  

  1. To fully digitise the construction of human civilisation
  2. To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society

The Role

Purpose of the role

As the IT Security Manager at Laminar, you will play a pivotal role in managing our IT security systems, identifying and closing any cybersecurity risk we hold, whilst also ensuring the smooth operation and development of the IT function. Your primary focus will be on maturing our security systems, ensuring adherence to industry standards, regulatory requirements, and best practices, particularly in alignment with relevant accreditations such as ISO 27001 and SOC2. Additionally, you will be responsible for all Laminar’s IT related policy and business rules, the managing of software, hardware and infrastructure management, and establishing SLAs for user support.

Team

Our IT team is the first port of call when things go wrong, and the first to spot trouble before it does. From fixing the everyday snags to keeping systems, networks, and data running securely behind the scenes, they keep the business moving so everyone else can get on with their work. Your leadership and coordination will ensure that the IT team continues to deliver high quality support for all departments within Laminar.

Your top three objectives

  1. Identify and mitigate IT security risks and close gaps in our systems.
  2. Ensure compliance with ISO 27001 and SOC2 standards and regulations.
  3. Develop and maintain a high-performing IT department.

Your top five responsibilities

  1. Lead strategic IT projects:Drive critical initiatives to ensure we proactively identify and close any security system risks whilst remaining compliant with ISO 27001 standards, regulations, and audit compliance.
  2. General IT Management: Including responsibility for and oversight of software, hardware and infrastructure management.
  3. Develop and enforce policies: Create and implement robust IT policies, procedures, and controls.
  4. Collaborate across teams: Align IT efforts with our goals through close collaboration with diverse teams and stakeholders, ensuring effective support and product ownership for core applications.
  5. Functional Leadership and promoting culture: Offer leadership on IT security, risk management, and compliance, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability, while also optimizing tools for support and ensuring efficient tech support across Laminar.

Your Capabilities

You will be a proven IT operations leader who knows how to switch between being a project manager, leader, communicator, researcher and doer, to make things better.

As a candidate, who should have:

Must-Have

  • Mastery: Strong understanding of IT security systems, where vulnerabilities are and how to close those gaps. You should have experience across both Microsoft and Google environments. You should also understand ISO 27001 standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices, along with proficiency in risk management, compliance management, and audit processes.
  • Communication: Precise and structured communicator, both written and verbal, in English.
  • Leadership: Ability to effectively manage teams and projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks effectively, and collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Impact: A track record of making workplaces better beyond just doing the basics.

Nice to Have

  • Mastery: Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CISA and knowledge of IT governance frameworks such as COBIT or ITIL is desirable.
  • Communication: Precise and structured communicator both written and verbal
  • Leadership: A proven leader, coach or developer of teams.
  • Impact: A track record of implementing scalable and repeatable solutions in projects and teams that had a significant positive impact on support desk operations, software/tech support, and IT infrastructure management.
Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true:
  • You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge
  • You like to be the smartest person in the room
  • You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback
  • You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team

Benefits

The Standard Stuff

  • Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage - for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority
  • Pension Scheme. A competitive plan to help you plan for the long term - plus salary sacrifice options available to maximize your savings
  • Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance
  • Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft
  • Cycle to Work Scheme. A tax-efficient way to get wheels - and do your bit for the environment

The Life-Changing Stuff

  • Flexibility: Getting things done is what really matters, not what time of day you do it. That means you don’t have to ask permission for things like picking up your kids or going to the doctor, just keep your team in the loop if you think they will be affected.
  • Grow your whole self:Our leaders are more like coaches and one of our main objectives is to give 5 years’ worth of learning and development for every 1 year with us. You have a coach, mentor, well-being therapist and a development-orientated environment: That’s literally what our vision is all about and the primary reason Laminar exists.
  • Be surrounded by the best: We only hire and retain the very best people. You might be used to being the smartest in the room but that won’t be the case in Laminar. You will be surrounded by people you can learn from. We are 100% meritocratic so fast progression is the norm. You will be supported to excel in whichever areas you are most interested in! With Laminar, development is unbounded
  • Long-term impact:We are focused on solving the biggest issues in construction project delivery in a way that can spread and outlast us

Important! Applying properly

We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:

  • Why do you want to join us?
  • If you joined, where do you think you could make the most impact and how?

We aren't a giant faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team so all applications will be read thoroughly by our key leaders. In terms of application, we usually start with an intro call to tell you what we are all about in a casual conversation. That helps you to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself.

jobs.description:
Location: Atlanta, GA / Remote

Department: Legal

Reports to: Assistant General Counsel – Privacy, AI, and Data Governance

Why Join Omnicell?

Omnicell is building its AI governance program and we are looking for a Manager, AI Vendor Governance to join our Legal Department and own how AI enters the company through third parties.

As a foundational member of Omnicell’s AI Governance Program, you will design and operate a third-party intake process that identifies AI solutions entering the organization, evaluates them against the company’s responsible-AI and risk standards, and determines the level of risk each presents to the business. Working closely with Procurement, Legal, Privacy, Security, Quality, and business owners, you will establish questionnaires, risk-tiering criteria, and review workflows that allow Omnicell to adopt AI tools quickly and responsibly.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

As a Manager, AI Vendor Governance, you will:

  • Primary Impact - Give Omnicell a clear, defensible view of every AI solution entering the business through a third party, so that teams can adopt AI tools quickly and with confidence, and so that customers, regulators, and patients can trust how those tools are vetted and governed.
  • Program build-out – Build, implement, and mature Omnicell’s AI vendor governance program, including its policies, standards, intake process, and review workflows
  • Third-party AI intake – Design and operate a third-party intake process that identifies AI solutions entering the organization, including AI embedded within broader products and services, and routes them for risk review
  • Risk tiering and classification – Develop risk-tiering and classification criteria that account for the AI use case, the sensitivity of the data involved, and the potential business impact of failure, bias, or misuse
  • Due diligence design – Create and maintain AI-specific due diligence questionnaires and assessment criteria covering model design, training data, transparency and explainability, bias mitigation, security, and ongoing monitoring
  • Vendor evidence review – Evaluate vendor documentation and control evidence, such as SOC 2 reports, ISO/IEC 42001 certifications, model cards, and impact assessments, and identify gaps that require remediation or compensating controls
  • Risk decisions – Determine and communicate the level of risk each AI solution presents, and partner with business owners on remediation, risk acceptance, or alternative approaches
  • AI inventory and shadow AI – Maintain an inventory of third-party AI in use across the organization, working to surface and govern shadow AI
  • Contractual requirements – Partner with Procurement and Legal to define contractual requirements for AI vendors, including disclosure of AI use, data handling, and responsible-AI commitments
  • Continuous monitoring – Establish continuous monitoring and periodic reassessment of AI vendors across the relationship lifecycle, from onboarding through offboarding
  • Metrics and regulatory tracking – Develop program metrics, reporting, and dashboards that demonstrate coverage, maturity, and risk posture to leadership, and track evolving AI regulations and standards, such as the EU AI Act and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, that affect third-party AI

Who You Are (Qualifications & Skills)

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in third-party or vendor risk management, IT or security risk, compliance, or a related governance function
  • Demonstrated experience building or substantially maturing a vendor risk or governance program, including intake and risk-tiering processes
  • Strong knowledge of third-party and vendor risk management principles and lifecycle, from intake and due diligence through monitoring and offboarding
  • Familiarity with AI and machine learning concepts and the risks they raise, including bias, transparency, data privacy, security, and model reliability
  • Working knowledge of AI governance frameworks and standards, such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act
  • Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks commonly used in vendor assessments, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and GDPR
  • A talent for designing clear, repeatable processes and operationalizing them across a cross-functional organization
  • The ability to assess complex risk and make pragmatic, risk-calibrated recommendations that balance innovation with protection of the business
  • A track record of partnering across Procurement, Legal, Privacy, Security, and business owners, with excellent stakeholder management skills
  • The ability to explain technical and risk concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • The ability to operate independently in a fast-moving environment, manage competing priorities, and stay highly organized, with sharp attention to detail and a commitment to thorough documentation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience assessing AI or machine learning solutions, or building AI-specific risk controls
  • Healthcare, life sciences, or other regulated-industry experience
  • Relevant certifications, such as AIGP, CIPP, CIPM, CTPRP, CRISC, CISA, or CISSP
  • Experience with third-party risk, GRC, or AI governance tooling, such as ServiceNow, OneTrust, or similar platforms
  • Familiarity with AI assurance artifacts, such as model cards, system cards, and impact assessments, and with vendor monitoring tools
  • Relevant advanced education, such as a degree or coursework in law, risk management, information security, data science, or a related field, or equivalent experience

Work Conditions

  • Flexibility in working hours as needed
  • Some travel, ~10%

Virtual Financial Advisor – Remote

St. Louis, MO

Bring your skills to a deeply purposeful, financially rewarding career

Thrivent is more than a financial services company – we’re a community that puts generosity at the heart of saving and investing. At Thrivent, you’ll have the opportunity to grow a meaningful career providing clients with purpose-based advice around investments, insurance, banking and generosity, empowering lives of service and faith.

As a Virtual Financial Advisor, you’ll play a vital role in delivering meaningful financial guidance that helps clients achieve greater financial confidence and take action. Leveraging Thrivent’s robust advice framework, you’ll use your strong interpersonal and consultative skills to connect with clients, build trust, and provide tailored recommendations that support their financial well-being.

This role focuses on re-engaging existing Thrivent clients—many of whom have not recently worked directly with a financial professional—by proactively reaching out to schedule and hold meaningful appointments via phone, shared screens, and video. You’ll also have the opportunity to engage and serve your own natural market.

Supported by Thrivent’s commitment to community engagement and a collaborative team environment, you’ll gain a strong foundation in sales and client service. Within 18-24 months, you’ll be equipped to join a local team or build your own practice with our support.

This is a remote role. You’ll meet with clients virtually using tools like Microsoft Teams and Zoom. You’ll also receive training and connect with your colleagues virtually, with occasional opportunities for in-person development and teambuilding.

Your Success; Our Blueprint

Nothing influences your success more than a solid roadmap to your growth. Your onboarding will be an immersive and engaging experience. You’ll receive the support, stability and opportunity of a Fortune 500 leader. And if you’re new to the financial services industry, we offer up to 3 months of pay and coaching as you obtain the state insurance and securities licenses necessary for this position.

Role Description

As a Virtual Financial Advisor at Thrivent, you’ll:

  • Leverage your relationship-building skills and build sales experience to engage clients with confidence and clarity.

  • Guide Christians and others who align with Thrivent’s mission and values to create and maintain their financial plans, enabling lives of service and faith.

  • Meet with clients virtually to provide personal, actionable and achievable advice and connect clients to Thrivent products and programs.

  • Have access to a large existing client base with the ability to also help your friends, family and natural market.

  • Access robust tools like the Thrivent Planning Platform, Salesforce, MoneyGuidePro® and Morningstar, and have modern computer hardware provided.

  • Get the support of collaborative culture with colleagues and leaders who want you to be successful and are willing to help you do so.

What You Bring

Our culture and our people are special. Whether you’re a seasoned sales professional or looking for a career change, you could be a successful Virtual Financial Advisor if you’re:

  • Self-disciplined, independent and driven to succeed.

  • Motivated by helping others and seeing them achieve their goals, not just selling products.

  • A natural coach or guide with strong interpersonal skills.

  • Positive, energetic and results oriented.

  • Collaborative and excited to contribute to your team.

Successful Thrivent financial advisors have come from a variety of career backgrounds, including outside sales, account executives, real estate, client services, hospitality, business development, recruiting, education, fundraisers, ministry and similar roles. Skills acquired in these fields transition well into the Virtual Financial Advisor role.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Military veterans are encouraged to apply.

  • FINRA Series 7, 63/65 or 66 required or obtained within 90 days.

  • State insurance licensed and appointed in life, health and variable lines of authority or obtained within 90 days.

  • Eligibility to be securities registered and insurance licensed in all 50 states.

  • Satisfactory background check (criminal and financial).

jobs.excerpt: About bunny. netSome people accept the internet as it is.
jobs.description:
About bunny.net

Some people accept the internet as it is. We see what it could be.

At bunny.net, we don’t wait for change. We make it happen. You won’t find layers of red tape or play-it-safe thinking here. You’ll find people who move quickly, take ownership, and push ideas all the way to the edge. Literally.

You’ll build things that solve actual problems, not add to them.

We’re not perfect, and we don’t pretend to be. But we’re always improving. We’re looking for people who want to do the same, who take pride in their work, and aren’t afraid to challenge what’s possible.

Because everyone deserves a better internet. And we’re here to help it hop faster.

CDN Support Engineer I

As a CDN Support Engineer I, you'll play a hands-on role helping developers deliver fast and reliable experiences across our global edge network, powered by 150 Tbps+ of capacity and 119+ edge locations worldwide.

This role is a great fit for someone who has already spent a few years supporting developer-facing infrastructure, whether in hosting, networking, cloud platforms, or video delivery, and wants to go deeper into the technologies that power the modern internet.

Our CDN Support Engineers own technical problems end-to-end, working directly with developers to diagnose issues, guide complex troubleshooting, and keep the internet running fast for the thousands of developers who trust bunny.net.

You won’t be figuring things out alone. Our Principal Support Engineers will coach you directly, working through real production issues together and helping you grow toward the responsibilities of a CDN Support Engineer II.

If your instinct when something breaks is to dig deeper until you understand why it happened, not just how to restore it, you’ll fit right in here.

Working hours:

You’ll rotate across support shifts and work alongside different Principal Support Engineers, gaining exposure to a wide range of production issues.

This role helps keep support coverage strong across shifts, which means stepping in to cover planned leave or unexpected absences. Being flexible around shifts is part of the role and comes with an additional shift allowance.

What will you do?

  • Help customers troubleshoot technical issues through Zendesk and Discord, providing clear explanations and effective solutions

  • Investigate delivery and performance issues involving caching, HTTP behavior, SSL/TLS, DNS configuration, and origin connectivity

  • Diagnose application-layer networking problems affecting website delivery and performance

  • Use tools like curl, traceroute, MTR, dig, and logs to analyze request flows and isolate production issues

  • Monitor network health and spot delivery problems before they escalate

  • Collaborate with our Engineering and Product teams when bugs or platform issues arise

  • Contribute improvements to internal troubleshooting guides and customer documentation

  • Share insights from customer interactions to help improve our platform and tooling

  • Continue developing your expertise in CDN architecture, caching systems, edge networking, and internet infrastructure

What will you bring?

  • 3+ years of experience supporting developer-facing infrastructure such as hosting platforms, networking services, cloud environments, or video delivery systems

  • A solid understanding of core internet technologies, including DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, headers, TLS/SSL, and caching

  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting production issues affecting live customer traffic

  • Confidence using diagnostic tools such as curl, dig, traceroute, or MTR

  • The ability to investigate technical problems methodically to identify root causes

  • Clear written communication and the ability to explain technical topics to developers in fluent English

  • A calm and structured approach when working on issues in production environments

  • Confidence working through problems that don’t always have an obvious answer

  • Genuine curiosity about how internet infrastructure works and a desire to keep learning

What will make us extra happy?

  • You’ve used bunny.net before

  • Great Spanish language skills

  • Experience supporting high-traffic websites, APIs, or streaming workloads

  • You’re genuinely curious about how the internet works and love digging into the details

  • You’ve worked in a startup environment and are comfortable moving fast, wearing multiple hats, and figuring things out as you go

Where should you be located?

All roles at bunny.net are fully remote. Work from wherever you hop best.

What's in it for you?

Life at bunny.net comes with benefits that make work (and life) better.

  • Remote-first by design - No offices, no commute, just the freedom to work anywhere. Miss the office? We’ll give you a 3-night voucher for visiting our headquarters.

  • Performance-based bonuses - Great work pays off, and we reward impact annually.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance - Coverage worldwide.

  • Paid time off - Love the slopes or the sea? Enjoy them with 25 vacation days, plus an extra loyalty day each year, capped at 5 years (30 days total), on top of your local public holidays.

  • Meeting-free Thursdays - We keep Thursdays meeting free internally so you can focus on deep work without interruptions.

  • Home office budget - We believe everyone is more efficient working in a comfortable office, and we're happy to help you set it up with an annual budget of €500.

  • Paid sick leave - Feeling ill? Take time off to fully recover without having to worry about your finances.

  • Parental leave - Paid 16 weeks for birthing parents, 8 weeks for non-birthing parents. If your country gives more, that’s your baseline. If it gives less, we top it up. Take your leave all at once or split it across the first year for maximum flexibility. After paid leave, your local statutory rules apply.

  • Annual fluffle building - We're remote, but not distant! Once a year, we meet in a sunny location where virtual high-fives turn into real ones.

  • Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) - Everyone at bunny.net gets a piece of the pie, starting with 0.01% equity.

  • Mental health support - Feeling down? We've got your back. bunny.net provides mental health resources and help via .

  • Wellness budget - An annual well-being budget of €480 is here to help you stay fresh and focused.

  • Educational budget - €500 yearly for books, seminars, or online courses to keep your learning on track, work-related or not.

  • Music on us: Work is better with music. Enjoy a yearly Apple, Spotify, or YouTube Premium subscription on us.

About ElitevoraSys

ElitevoraSys is a modern engineering consultancy focused on building high-performance operational platforms, automation pipelines, and data-driven workflows for clients who need real results - not just software. We partner with organizations to design and deliver systems that streamline dispatch, asset management, field operations, and enterprise integrations. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to help expand WorkPro, our flagship operations platform deployed across multiple client environments. You'll work in a small, senior team, own services end-to-end across the stack, and help shape the technical direction of a system used daily by real operational teams.

This role is perfect for an experienced full-stack engineer who enjoys solving complex workflow problems, building reliable APIs, and working across modern and legacy systems.

Backend & Integrations

Team & Delivery

  • Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and production deployments.

  • Own backend features from design through release.

Preferred

  • Experience with Dynamics 365, Power Automate, or Logic Apps.

  • Build and quality tooling: Maven/Gradle, pip/poetry, NuGet, Go modules, SonarQube, static analysis.

  • Deeper experience with AI-assisted development or LLM-backed workflows (prompt engineering, RAG, agentic tooling).

jobs.description:
Taxwell helps everyday Americans get every tax advantage they deserve by finding credits and deductions they never even knew existed. Our tax preparation software offers easy guidance and ensures your maximum tax refund. We strive to build a team of like-minded experts in both tax and technology who align with our brand purpose, are advocates for our customers and have a fresh, non-traditional approach to the tax industry.

Taxwell is a leading digital tax filing platform formed in 2022 from the combination of Drake Software® and TaxAct®. These two longstanding organizations offer customers professional and do-it-yourself digital and downloadable products that are easy-to-use, best-in-class technology, and provide unparalleled customer support. Taxwell brands are a trusted solution for all users including those with complex tax returns. We strive to attract and retain candidates who exemplify our values: performance, perseverance, progress and partnership. Taxwell is an organization of forward thinkers looking to add industry experts to our growing team.


Position Summary

TaxWell is hiring a Software Engineering Manager for the Data Import team. This team builds the systems that help TaxAct, Drake Software, and Taxwell users import tax documents and related financial data into the tax-preparation experience — document upload, OCR and extraction workflows, document classification, import state tracking, partner and financial-institution integrations, and the operational diagnostics that keep production import pipelines healthy.


This is a player-coach leadership role on a cloud-backed, event-driven platform. You will lead and develop a team of software engineers (employees and contractors) building business-critical services in modern C#/.NET on AWS, own the team's delivery outcomes, and be technical enough to earn credibility in architecture, code review, and production debugging.


What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of software engineers: hiring, onboarding, performance, professional development, and career growth.
  • Own the team's delivery: planning, prioritization, work assignments, resource planning, commitments to Product, and follow-through to production.
  • Own onboarding speed and engineer productivity as explicit outcomes. You build the scaffolding that makes fast ramp normal — not the exception: scoped first tasks sized for early merges, review and pairing support, progressive exposure to production debugging, and the judgment to notice and act when a new engineer isn't ramping.
  • Provide technical direction across services and systems: guide design and architecture for document-processing pipelines (ingestion, OCR, classification, extraction, state, delivery), balancing product velocity against security, compliance, and reliability requirements.
  • Run and continuously improve the team's engineering practices: CI/CD and release management on a frequent release cadence, automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end), observability, production incident response, and blameless post-incident learning.
  • Support adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering tools across the team, with clear standards for reviewing AI-generated output for correctness, security, and maintainability. The engineer remains accountable for all output.
  • Coordinate with platform and security teams when centrally-driven infrastructure, hardening, or compliance work lands on the team's services, so it strengthens the product rather than crowding it out.
  • Troubleshoot complex, cross-service production issues alongside your engineers: application code, queues, object storage, state records, configuration, logs, and external dependencies.
  • Communicate clearly and honestly with Product and business stakeholders: tradeoffs, risks, estimates, delivery status, and operational health.

What You'll Need


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.
  • Approximately 8+ years of professional software development experience, with a minimum of 2 years leading or managing software engineers who shipped production software.
  • Strong hands-on background in C#/.NET and backend product engineering: APIs, event-driven and asynchronous processing, and cloud-service integration.
  • Working knowledge of cloud-native architectures, preferably AWS serverless (Lambda, SQS, S3, DynamoDB or close equivalents); Azure experience is a reasonable substitute if fundamentals are strong.
  • Experience owning or jointly owning production support for business-critical services: triage, impact assessment, rollback thinking, and escalation judgment.
  • Demonstrated ability to hire, onboard, and ramp engineers quickly, with concrete examples of engineers who became productive under your leadership.
  • Strong leadership, communication, coaching, and problem-solving skills, with the judgment to know when to fix, escalate, delegate, or hold the line.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing teams that built document processing, OCR, classification, extraction, data-ingestion, or other event-driven data pipeline systems.
  • Experience in tax, financial services, accounting, payments, or other regulated domains handling sensitive customer data.
  • Experience managing mixed employee/contractor and distributed or nearshore teams, with clear productivity accountability for each.
  • Experience with Kubernetes-based deployment, observability tooling (Splunk, Datadog, or CloudWatch), and structured logging/metrics practices.
  • Hands-on experience governing AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) on an engineering team — raising the bar, not just permitting the tools.

About the Team's Culture This team values pragmatic product engineering: production safety, careful discovery before changing unfamiliar flows, clear diagnostics and documentation, blameless production learning, useful collaboration with support/product/QA/platform partners, and thoughtful use of AI and automation

JAVA ENGINEERING LEAD – CUSTOMER COMMUNICATION MANAGEMENT (ENGINEER II/III)
Brand, Marketing & Communications | Mutual of Omaha Information Services

Mutual of Omaha is expanding its Brand, Marketing & Communications (BMC) program to launch a newly approved, enterprise-wide Customer Communication Management (CCM) platform. This is not a backfill – it is a new role created to help build something from the ground up. The CCM platform will give our customers control over how they receive information from Mutual of Omaha, moving statements and benefit communications that were traditionally printed and mailed to secure digital delivery. The result: a better customer experience and meaningful cost savings for the company.

As the Engineering Lead for the CCM platform, you will set the technical direction and engineering standards across a set of interconnected applications – spanning greenfield development, enterprise scaling of existing applications, and integration with vendor and internal systems. You will serve as a Solution Lead, starting with a newly formed discovery team and continuing as the platform expands into dedicated delivery teams.

This role combines technical leadership with hands-on engineering (approximately 40–50% coding). The ideal candidate is an experienced solution or engineering lead who enjoys building new platforms, keeps teams honest on engineering practices, and is energized by shaping a multi-year transformation of how Mutual of Omaha communicates with its customers.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary:
    • Engineer II - $125,000 - $140,000, plus annual bonus opportunity
    • Engineer III - $150,000 - $163,000, plus annual bonus opportunity
  • Benefits and Perks: 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match
  • Time Off: Up to 15 days of vacation annually, plus 11 paid holidays including 2 floating holidays
  • Work Arrangement: Remote, with occasional in-person team events (approximately once per year for 3–4 days)
  • Eligibility: Applicants must not now, nor in the future, require employment sponsorship

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Platform Engineering Leadership: Serve as the overall engineering lead for the CCM platform, establishing and enforcing engineering standards, patterns, and practices across interconnected applications to ensure they are scalable, maintainable, and ready for future growth.
  • Solution Leadership: Act as Solution Lead for the CCM discovery team and future delivery teams, coordinating closely with other Solution Leads to align designs, dependencies, and delivery across the program.
  • Hands-On Development: Spend roughly 40–50% of your time coding – building greenfield applications and enhancing and scaling existing applications using Java, MuleSoft, and AWS.
  • Discovery & Build-vs-Buy Analysis: Assess the capabilities and gaps of existing applications, estimate the effort to make them enterprise-ready, and evaluate vendor solutions to recommend where to build versus buy. Findings will directly shape the 2027 critical path plan.
  • Platform Capabilities: Help design and deliver core CCM capabilities, including a decision engine, a customer consent and preference center, workflow management, and analytics tracking – along with integrations to Salesforce and third-party tools.
  • Mentorship & Collaboration: Mentor and guide engineers on the team and partner with QA, business analysts, and technical leadership within a SAFe Agile environment (three-week sprints, quarterly PI planning).
  • AI-Enabled Engineering: Champion the use of AI tools and agents to accelerate development, improve code quality, and increase team productivity.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience as a Solution Lead, Engineering Lead, or Technical Lead.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java and AWS cloud services.
  • Experience with MuleSoft or similar integration platforms, including API design and system-to-system integration.
  • Proven track record of building applications from scratch and taking them from concept to production.
  • Experience scaling and modernizing existing applications for enterprise-wide use.
  • Ability to define and uphold engineering standards across multiple applications and teams.
  • Experience with CI/CD practices and tooling, including GitHub.
  • Experience leading and mentoring other engineers.
  • Comfortable working in SAFe Agile environments and contributing to PI planning within Agile Release Trains (ART).

If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

As a Distinguished Forward Deployed Engineer for Prisma AIRS, you will serve as the principal technical authority embedded within strategic enterprise engineering teams. Operating at the intersection of AI safety, zero-trust architecture, and distributed systems, you will architect, build, and deploy secure enterprise-grade AI workloads to production. You will write highly performant code, define industry-leading deployment standards, and bridge high-impact enterprise environments with core product engineering.   • Lead Architectural Design Reviews to build zero-trust, high-availability AI safety topologies across enterprise environments.
  • Write production-grade code (Python, Go, C++) integrating Prisma AIRS into enterprise microservices and AI infrastructure.
  • Build high-throughput middleware and proxy extensions for real-time prompt security and identity-aware access controls.
  • Architect automated IaC deployment modules and SDK wrappers to accelerate rapid enterprise product adoption.
  • Optimize low-latency traffic paths for streaming LLM payloads, intelligent caching, and global load balancing.
  • Serve as the ultimate tier-4 escalation point for mission-critical production outages and complex distributed systems.
  • Analyze telemetry pipelines to resolve edge-case failures across agentic frameworks like LangChain and LlamaIndex.
  • Upstream custom plugins, platform optimizations, and core engine enhancements to primary Prisma AIRS repositories.
  • Partner with cross-functional leadership to convert recurring enterprise architectural patterns into native product capabilities.
  • Author enterprise reference architectures and whitepapers to establish industry standards for AI security and compliance.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Master-level proficiency in Python, Go, or C++, with expertise in asynchronous programming and high-concurrency systems.

Veeva's Vault Clinical Data Management System (CDMS) is changing how life sciences companies manage clinical trial data, bringing EDC, coding, and Veeva Data Quality System (DQS) together in one platform.   • Coordinate with clinical data providers (central labs, ECG, eCOA, IRT, etc.) to configure data transfers
  • Configure forms, rules, and other study items in Vault CDMS, and build custom SQL-based listings for customer data cleaning needs
  • Run on-site or remote user acceptance testing, managing feedback, issue resolution, and study acceptance
  • Support requirements gathering and specification writing for study integrations and go-live activities
  • Flag risks and contingency plans to project management to keep the project compliant with regulatory and Veeva procedures
  • Contribute to process, product, and best-practice initiatives, and support developers and testers throughout the project lifecycle

  • Configure and support data imports into Veeva DQS

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience with EDC clinical software, covering end-to-end data management (database design, data collection, data analysis, query resolution, datasets, statistical reporting)
  • Solid understanding of clinical trial processes, particularly around data collection and review
  • Programming experience in languages such as SAS, R, JSON, Python, or SQL, with the ability to pick up new SQL-based languages
  • Background in the life sciences industry (pharma, biotech, medical device, CRO, or academic/public health), with experience across project assessment, planning, development, training, and implementation

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while meeting project timelines
  • Strong verbal and written communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills
  • Willingness to travel up to 10%, potentially including international travel

Nice to Have

  • Experience translating clinical protocols into software specifications, including technical documentation
  • Experience with Veeva applications
  • Located near a major life sciences hub
  • Degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field
